ranked.name: C27_Buyback_Decision_Drift
ranked.data_source: DART tsstkAqDecsn API (취득예정금액/방법/기간), rcept_dt PIT, RAWDATA Size for intensity scaling.
ranked.rationale: The cleanest top-concentration engine in the set: a board buyback decision is a genuine BINARY occurrence gate — non-event names get a structural zero, so D1-D8 are mechanically flat and only event firms populate D9-D10, with D10 = largest-intensity direct-method buybacks. This is categorically different from the 9 failures, which were ALL continuous cross-sectional ranks that diffused signal into short/mid. The mechanism (costly credible insider commitment + mechanical demand bid over the execution window + post-announcement underreaction drift) is well-grounded (Ikenberry) and intrinsically long/buy-side, directly defusing the AX-007 no-short trap. KR Value-up surge (2023+) makes it timely AND well-populated. Feasibility=3 (not higher) because tsstkAqDecsn must be parsed from DART list.json (no cached table), and pre-2015 coverage may thin the early campaign window. Top tier on the dominant axis.

ranked.name: M_BuybackDrift_Confirmed
ranked.data_source: stock_buyback.parquet (302k SBB rows, PIT Factor_Date, 2000-2026) + RAWDATA OHLCV M03 momentum confirmation.
ranked.rationale: Same binary-event top-concentration mechanism as C27 (event-driven → flat baseline → D10 spike) but with a decisive feasibility advantage: a CACHED, PIT-clean stock_buyback.parquet (302k rows, Factor_Date embedded) already exists — no DART extraction blocker. The momentum-confirmation gate (buyback × M03>median) filters value-trap/defensive buybacks, a real precision lever. Slightly lower mechanism/novelty than C27 because the momentum overlay re-introduces a price-momentum element that overlaps the M* family and could shift signal toward names already moving (mild redundancy risk), and M03 confirmation could thin the spike. But on top-concentration (the heaviest axis) it is co-leader, and it is the most immediately buildable of the entire set. Tier A.

ranked.name: C29_Index_Inclusion_Frontrun_Drift
ranked.data_source: us_k200.parquet / us_kq150.parquet (640 K200 0->1 transitions verified), RAWDATA Size for index-weight scaling.
ranked.rationale: Purest exogenous top-concentration: index inclusion is a binary, calendar-clustered, committee-driven event (~15-25 K200 entrants/yr), so D1-D9 are a structural-zero bulk and D10 is just-included names scaled by passive demand footprint. The mechanism (forced passive + index-benchmarked buying = mechanical price pressure, Shleifer/Chen-Noronha-Singal index effect) is exogenous and NOT a firm signal arbitrageurs have competed away — strongest causal cleanliness in the set. Buy-side only (AX-007 escape). Two honest penalties: (1) PIT risk — the parquet flag flips at EFFECTIVE date but KR pre-announces ~2-4wk prior; must lag to announcement to avoid C2/C5 look-ahead, and if only effective-date flags exist this needs conservative handling (feasibility=3); (2) very low event frequency (~20/yr) means non-rebalance months yield a sparse top-20 book — best as a holding-extended sleeve/overlay, slightly denting kr_fit. Still Tier A on dominant axis.

ranked.name: C28_Insider_Cluster_Conviction_Buy
ranked.data_source: DART elestock (data_collector_dart_insider.R wired; cache 2024-2026 9790 rows, needs multi-year backfill). sp_stock_lmp_irds_rate, isu_exctv_rgist_at, repror for distinct-buyer count.
ranked.rationale: Two stacked rarity gates (insider open-market BUY occurred AT ALL × MULTIPLE distinct insiders clustered) produce extreme top-concentration — D1-D9 = no-cluster bulk, only D10 = multi-insider conviction cluster. Mechanism is top-tier (Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski opportunistic-cluster informativeness; named insiders are the sharpest information source, categorically distinct from the anonymous aggregate flows C21/C22 that already failed). Buy-side only (AX-007 escape). The decisive drag is feasibility=2: the elestock cache is only 2024-2026 (9790 rows) and pre-2015 DART OpenAPI insider coverage is genuinely sparse — reaching the 2005+ campaign window for statistical power on a rare-event signal is a real, honestly-flagged risk. The cluster-gate further thins events, raising the chance the top-20 book can't be filled in many months. High potential, real build/power risk.

ranked.name: M37_Buyback_Confirmed_Breakout
ranked.data_source: RAWDATA OHLC (Donchian/base breakout) + DART buyback/insider disclosure within trailing window, rcept_dt PIT.
ranked.rationale: Co-occurrence of two independent rare events (confirmed price breakout × DART buyback/insider disclosure) gives the MOST extreme top-concentration in the set — a near-degenerate flat-then-spike where only D10 is populated. Mechanism is sound (technical breakout + informed-capital imprimatur + ongoing buyback bid). But this very extremity is also its weakness: the candidate itself flags breadth may fall well below 20 names/month, making standalone top-20 graduation hard — the author honestly recommends it as an OVERLAY on M33/M35, not standalone. Feasibility=2 (no clean cached buyback-event table per its own text — it routes to raw data_collector_dart, contradicting M_BuybackDrift's cleaner parquet, and adds an OHLC-join). Distinct enough from M_BuybackDrift (adds breakout gate) to keep, but the thinness pushes it to B.

ranked.name: M_TripleRevisionUnanimity
ranked.data_source: QuantiWise consensus C02 (EPS chg), C17 (OP), C14 (revenue), C04 (ESBR breadth). COUNT of lines up, gated ESBR>0.6.
ranked.rationale: Strongest of the consensus AND-gate concepts. Non-compensatory unanimity (EPS AND OP AND Revenue all up + breadth) is a genuine rarity gate — the three lines diverge often, so count=3+breadth isolates a small genuine-fundamental-acceleration set, distinct from C19's compensatory z-average that mid-peaks. Top-concentration=4 not 5: unlike binary corporate events, the underlying inputs are still continuous revision magnitudes thresholded, so the D10 spike is softer than an event gate, and there's residual risk the shape ramps rather than spikes. But mechanism is causally clear (broad-based upgrade = structural, underreacted), feasibility is maximal (all four fields in the consensus schema, no new collection), and it's cleanly orthogonal to the 9 path/flow failures. The strongest no-new-data candidate; deserves a real test.

ranked.name: C30_Major_Holder_Stake_Build
ranked.data_source: DART elestock isu_main_shrholdr=Y + positive sp_stock_lmp_irds_rate + 대량보유상황보고 majorstock API, rcept_dt PIT.
ranked.rationale: 5%+ major-holder stake-INCREASE event with threshold+magnitude double-gate — genuine event concentration (D1-D9 flat, D10 = large informed accumulation). Mechanism solid (single committed informed actor, 13D-style continued-buying drift), buy-side (AX-007 escape), and distinct from C28 (single 5%+ holder large build vs officer cluster) and from INV11 (named discrete event vs anonymous continuous concentration). Penalized vs the buyback events on two fronts: (1) signal-purity — major-holder filings include non-informational intra-group/controlling-family transfers (Value-up activist noise), requiring filer-type parsing to avoid contaminating the gate, which both dents mechanism cleanliness and lowers feasibility; (2) shares the elestock backfill/coverage risk (feasibility=2). Real concept, but noisier and harder to clean than the buyback siblings.

ranked.name: M33_Confirmed_Donchian_Breakout
ranked.data_source: RAWDATA OHLC only — Close vs rolling 252d max(High) excl current bar, base-length>=126d gate, close-confirmation. PIT t-1.
ranked.rationale: Reframes 52w-high from a CONTINUOUS RATIO (M06, diffuse mid-peaking) into a discrete FIRST-CROSSING EVENT after a >=126d base with close-confirmation — a real top-concentration upgrade (flat D1-D8, spike D9-D10) using zero external data (max feasibility, fully PIT-clean). Mechanism=3 (the honest discount): the overhead-supply/disposition-effect story is plausible and KR-amplified by retail disposition, but it is still fundamentally PRICE-momentum — closer to the existing M* family in spirit than the corporate-event candidates, and price breakouts have a documented failure rate (false breaks) that this raw version doesn't filter. Distinct from M06 (event vs ratio) and worth testing precisely because it's free and immediately buildable, but the causal edge is weaker than the insider-capital concepts. M35 is its quality-filtered superior.

ranked.name: M36_RelStrength_Breakout_vs_Index
ranked.data_source: RAWDATA Close + BM_Ret (already present) — RS line = cum(stock)/cum(BM), rolling 126/252d max, new-RS-high event + absolute new-high dual-gate. PIT t-1.
ranked.rationale: Directly targets the campaign's deepest lesson — KR long-only signal gets swamped by the shared market component (β≈0.99, gross-cor 0.78). By ranking RS-LINE new-highs (price/benchmark), it strips market beta AT THE SIGNAL LEVEL, so the surviving D10 is genuinely idiosyncratic leadership, not beta-riders — the one breakout candidate that explicitly addresses the active-vs-gross distinction in §6 of the constitution. Dual-gate (RS new-high AND absolute new-high) concentrates to a few true leaders. BM_Ret already in RAWDATA (feasibility=4, near-trivial join). Top-concentration=4 (event-crossing, not binary corporate event; could still ramp). Mechanism=4 (leadership-rotation diffusion is plausible and KR theme-rotation makes it timely, but it remains a price-derived signal). A genuinely thoughtful breakout variant that I rank above M33/M34 for its beta-neutralization.

ranked.name: M35_Stage2_Base_Breakout_Quality
ranked.data_source: RAWDATA OHLC+Vol — base length>=126d, base tightness (intra-base MDD), volume-confirmed pivot clear. PIT t-1.
ranked.rationale: Quality-filtered superior of M33: multiplicative AND-gate (long base × tight base × volume-confirmed pivot) compresses signal harder into D10 and fixes the false-positive breaks M33 admits. Mechanism=3 (Weinstein/O'Neil stage analysis: tight base = strong-hands accumulation, low overhead supply → durable markup) is the same price-structure family as M33, so it inherits the 'still price-momentum' discount, and the strict AND-gates create the candidate's own honestly-flagged risk that qualifying names sometimes fall below 20/month (forcing gate relaxation or cash). Feasibility=4 (free OHLCV data but more parameters to tune than M33). Kept as a distinct, better-concentrated breakout variant, but I'd test M36 (beta-neutral) and M33 (simpler) ahead of it on a head-to-head.

ranked.name: M_ConfCount_AndGate
ranked.data_source: RAWDATA OHLCV (M01, 20d/60d ADV), QuantiWise C04 ESBR, investor flow INV09 persistence. COUNT in top tercile (0..4).
ranked.rationale: Four-channel non-compensatory AND-gate (price × earnings-revision × liquidity × smart-money persistence all top-tercile). Top-concentration=3 — the honest concern: it INCLUDES a flow channel (INV09 persistence), and the campaign showed flow signals land short-leg/mid; AND-gating four diffuse continuous ranks does manufacture rarity, but the prompt explicitly warns that combining failed continuous ranks is risky, and the ~1.2% all-four probability assumes independence the channels don't truly have (price and revision-momentum are correlated, shrinking the gate's discriminating power). Real but the inclusion of the failed-flow channel and the diffuse-rank-combination basis hold it to C.

ranked.name: TCFI_TripleChannel_Fundamental_Inflection
ranked.data_source: QuantiWise revenue_fy1/op_profit_fy1/eps_1y second differences + margin accel. Boolean AND each >80th pctile. PIT Date<sig_date.
ranked.rationale: Triple second-derivative AND-gate (revenue accel × OP accel × margin accel) targeting genuine business inflection vs single-line flukes. Mechanism=4 (operating-leverage / multi-dimensional regime-shift underreaction is causally clean and KR-amplified). Feasibility=5 (all fields in consensus schema). But it overlaps heavily with M_TripleRevisionUnanimity (both are consensus triple-AND-gates) — M_TripleRevisionUnanimity uses levels+breadth, TCFI uses second-differences+margin; same family, and TCFI's second-difference of consensus trajectories is noisier (acceleration of estimates is a thin, jumpy series), softening the D10 spike (top-concentration=3). Novelty=3 given the sibling. Kept over its near-twins SSCE/MACOL but ranked C as a redundant-family member to M_TripleRevisionUnanimity, which I prefer for cleaner inputs.

specs.name: C27_Buyback_Decision_Drift
specs.construction:
EVENT-GATED INTENSITY signal (NOT a continuous cross-sectional rank — this is the structural fix vs the 9 continuous failures and vs the sibling C23_OtherCorp which scored rank-IC 0.020/harvey 3.38 yet port_t −0.52 / all 27 grid cells negative because a continuous z diffused into a flat top decile).

DEFINITION OF THE EVENT: a board resolution to acquire treasury shares — DART '주요사항보고서(자기주식취득 결정)', captured by the structured endpoint tsstkAqDecsn (취득예정주식: aqpln_stk_ostk 보통주 / aqpln_stk_estk 우선주; 취득예정금액: aqpln_prc_ostk + aqpln_prc_estk; 취득방법: aq_mth=직접취득/신탁계약; 취득기간 aq_pp_bgn_de~aq_pp_end_de; rcept_no PIT).

SIGNAL CONSTRUCTION (monthly signal date t = month-end trading day):
  Step A — EVENT GATE (binary, the engine):
    event_active_i(t) = 1  if firm i has >=1 buyback DECISION with Usable_Date(rcept) <= t AND t falls inside an ACTIVE drift window [Usable_Date, Usable_Date + DRIFT_M months]; else 0.
    Non-event firms get event_active=0 and are EXCLUDED from the long candidate set entirely (they are structurally not D9-D10 — this is what makes the top steep instead of flat).
  Step B — INTENSITY (continuous, only WITHIN event firms, for ranking the D9/D10 boundary):
    intensity_i(t) = ln(1 + planned_amount_i / Size_i_{t-1})    # 취득예정금액 / 시가총액(t-1), the costly-commitment magnitude (Ikenberry scales drift by buyback size)
    where planned_amount = aqpln_prc_ostk + coalesce(aqpln_prc_estk,0). If 금액 NA but 주식수 present: planned_amount := aqpln_stk_ostk * Close_{t-1} (PIT price). If both NA -> intensity from 주식수/상장주식수 fallback; if all NA -> intensity = group-median (event still counts, magnitude unknown).
    method_mult = 1.00 if aq_mth contains '직접' (direct open-market — mechanical demand bid, Ikenberry's strongest), 0.60 if '신탁'(trust — looser commitment).
    freshness_decay = exp(-elapsed_months / HALF_LIFE)  where elapsed = months since most-recent decision's Usable_Date (drift is front-loaded; decays over the execution window).
    score_i(t) = event_active_i(t) * method_mult_i * intensity_i(t) * freshness_decay_i(t)
  Step C — PORTFOLIO: among event_active==1 firms passing liquidity (t-1 ADV>=2e8) and index membership (K200∪KQ150 at t), take top_n by score (EW long-only). If event-firm count in a month < top_n, hold only the available event firms EW (genuine concentration — do NOT backfill with non-event names; backfilling reintroduces the C23 dilution failure).

Headline pre-registered config: DRIFT_M=12, HALF_LIFE=6, method_mult as above, top_n=20, intensity=ln(1+amount/Size). All else = lookback_grid robustness (diagnostic, not argmax-selected -> selection_type='chain', DSR advisory).
specs.estimator:
Real-computation via 02_Infrastructure/contracts/canonical_screen_bt.R::canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt=ADV_t-1). metric_type='canonical_screen' (screening, NOT admission-binding — forge build_bt_result is authoritative if it graduates).

Authoritative gate metric = portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (NW lag-3, returned by build_benchmark_compare via canonical_screen_bt). rank-IC / ICIR / harvey_t are ADVISORY ONLY and explicitly subordinated — the C23 sibling proved a clean rank-IC 0.020 / harvey 3.38 with port_t −0.52, so headline must be port_t, never the cross-sectional rank metric.

Cross-sectional rank within event firms uses frank (rank-invariant, heavy-tail robust on planned_amount/Size). NO full-sample statistics anywhere (C1): intensity uses only Size_{t-1}/Close_{t-1}; the gate uses only Usable_Date<=t filings.

Decile/event-vs-nonevent comparison estimator: since the strategy holds only event firms, the top_concentration_test (see field) is run on the FULL cross-section (all liquid K200∪KQ150 names assigned score; non-event = 0) ONCE for diagnostics, to measure D10 (largest direct-method buybacks) vs D9 vs D1-D8 (the structural-zero mass) — this verifies the event gate actually puts realized excess return in the extreme top, which is the whole thesis.
specs.lookback_grid:
DRIFT_M (post-decision drift window, months): {6, 9, 12, 18} — Ikenberry documents drift out to ~12-48m; KR likely faster. PRIMARY=12.
HALF_LIFE (freshness decay, months): {3, 6, 12, Inf(no decay)} — Inf tests whether decay helps. PRIMARY=6.
intensity transform: {ln(1+amount/Size), raw amount/Size, sqrt(amount/Size), within-event frank(amount/Size)} — PRIMARY=ln(1+amount/Size). The frank variant is the robustness check that the result is not driven by a few giant won-amount outliers.
method_mult (direct vs trust): {[1.0,0.6](primary), [1.0,1.0](method-agnostic), [1.0,0.0](direct-only)} — direct-only tests Ikenberry's mechanical-bid channel in isolation.
top_n: {15, 20, 25} — PRIMARY=20 (mandate max 25). Because event months can be thin, also report the realized held-count distribution per month.
Total grid = 4×4×4×3×3 = 576 cells but PRIMARY is a single pre-registered config; grid is a robustness surface (report % of cells with port_t>0 and the primary cell's rank within the surface). selection_type='chain' (single hypothesis, pre-registered primary) -> DSR advisory, not a HARD gate.
specs.data_inputs:
DART buyback decisions (NEW collector required — no cached table exists, hence proposer feasibility=3):
  - Endpoint 1 (list discovery): opendart list.json with pblntf_ty='I'(발행공시) and pblntf_ty='B'(주요사항보고서), report_nm regex '자기주식.*취득.*결정|자기주식취득결정' (mirror data_collector_dart_insider.R::.fetch_insider_list pagination loop, page_count=100, all months yr×mo).
  - Endpoint 2 (structured detail): opendart tsstkAqDecsn.json?crtfc_key&corp_code&bgn_de&end_de. Columns to persist: rcept_no, corp_code, aqpln_stk_ostk, aqpln_stk_estk, aqpln_prc_ostk, aqpln_prc_estk, aq_mth(취득방법), aq_pp_bgn_de, aq_pp_end_de, aq_wtn_div_ostk(장내/장외). Amounts parsed via gsub(',','') -> numeric (mirror .parse_amount).
  - corp_code↔Ticker via .cache/dart/corpcode_map.parquet (Ticker='A'+stock_code).
  - New cache: .cache/dart/buyback_decisions.parquet, written via temp-rename pattern (Windows arrow mmap 1224 guard — see data_collector_dart.R fix lines 295-301).
RAWDATA (.cache/rawdata*.parquet, via existing loader — columns Ticker/Date/Close/Vol/Size/Ret/Sector): Size_{t-1} for intensity scaling, Close_{t-1} for amount fallback, Ret for forward Ret_1m, 20d ADV (Vol*Close rolling mean, t-1) for liquidity (C10).
Index membership (K200/KQ150 point-in-time table) for universe gate at t.
Benchmark: bench_dt(Date, BM_Ret) = KOSPI200 total return (canonical_screen_bt expects BM_Ret column).
QuantiWise: NOT required for primary (kept out to avoid scope creep); optional orthogonality covariate only.
specs.pit_notes:
Follows the proven fe_disclosure_meta.R PIT template exactly (that file self-asserts and passes):
  C1 (no full-sample stat): intensity uses only point-in-time Size_{t-1}/Close_{t-1}; gate uses only filings with Usable_Date<=t; cross-sectional frank is per-date independent (not pooled). No expanding/full-sample moments.
  C2 (no same-day circular): rcept_date = as.Date(substr(rcept_no,1,8)); Usable_Date = next_tday(rcept_date) so a decision disclosed on day d is usable from d+1 trading day. Same-day-of-decision return never enters.
  C4/C5 (filing lag): the buyback DECISION itself IS the timestamped event (rcept_dt is the market-observable disclosure instant) — no separate financial-statement lag needed; the t-1 settlement/usability is the only lag, enforced by Usable_Date.
  C6 (survivorship): universe is point-in-time K200∪KQ150 membership at t; delisted/merged names retained up to delisting.
  C10 (liquidity uses t-1): ADV = rolling 20d mean(Vol*Close) shifted to t-1, never current-month volume.
  C13 (no manual sign flip): score is directly long = buy (larger direct-method buyback -> higher score); no NEGATE/FLIP, sign is economically forced by Ikenberry mechanism.
  C14 (Usable_Date<=sig_date): built-in assertion replicated from fe_disclosure_meta lines 114-119: SIG[, max(Usable_Date) by Date] must be <= Date or stop(). 
  C15 (factor_db routing): buyback decisions are a NEW raw DART channel absent from Factor DB (same documented carve-out as C23_OtherCorp's load_investor_stock and fe_disclosure_meta's dart_raw cache) — routed via the dedicated buyback_decisions.parquet, NOT load_month_factors. Orthogonality COVARIATES (the existing factors we correlate against) ARE pulled via load_month_factors. Document this as pit_c15_exception=documented_spec_sanctioned in the alpha_package (identical justification to C23).
Data floor: DART structured tsstkAqDecsn coverage thins pre-2015 (proposer flagged). Expect usable signal ~2016+ (same as fe_disclosure_meta). Label floor explicitly; do NOT claim 2005 mandate coverage. The KR Value-up surge (2023+) is the well-populated regime — report event-firm count per month and flag thin early months (e.g. fewer than top_n event firms) as data caveats, not as held-position decisions.
specs.top_concentration_test:
PURPOSE: prove the binary event gate makes the extreme top STEEP (real excess return concentrated in D10), unlike C23 where the top was flat. Procedure:

1. FULL cross-section decile profile (run once, diagnostic): each month assign score to ALL liquid K200∪KQ150 names (non-event=0). Because most names are 0, D1-D8 are the structural-zero mass — REPORT them as a single pooled 'no-event' bucket plus the event names split into deciles D? by score. Concretely: among event_active firms only, cut into deciles by score; non-event firms = 'D0'. Compute mean forward net-active return (vs BM) for D0, D1..D10 and plot the monotone profile.
2. D10 t-stat: form the D10-only EW long-only monthly net-active series (top 10% of event firms by score = largest direct-method buybacks); compute NW lag-3 t-stat of mean active return via the SAME build_benchmark_compare path canonical_screen_bt uses. PASS thesis if D10 port_t is materially positive and is the steepest bucket.
3. D10-D9 gap: long D10 / measure D9 separately; gap_return = mean(D10_active) - mean(D9_active), with NW lag-3 t-stat on the difference series. A positive significant gap = the EXTREME intensity (giant direct buybacks) carries the edge, not merely 'any buyback'. If gap<=0 -> the event gate works but intensity-sorting does not, route as binary-event-EW (drop intensity).
4. EVENT vs MARKET test: mean active return of ALL event firms (event_active==1, EW) vs 0 — isolates the pure announcement-drift effect from the intensity tilt. This is the Ikenberry base case; if even this is flat, the catalyst itself has no KR drift and the whole concept fails (report as clean negative, AX-000).
5. Concentration sanity: report realized held-name count per month (event thinness) and top20_illiquid_share. Cross-check that D10 outperformance is NOT a micro-cap liquidity artifact (event firms tilt small in KR) — recompute D10 port_t restricted to Size>median to confirm it survives in liquid names.
DECISION: graduation-relevant headline = the top_n=20 event-gated portfolio's portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 from canonical_screen_bt (must clear 2.95 HARD with oos_retention>=0.7, calmar>=0.64). The decile test is the MECHANISM evidence that this number is real and top-concentrated, not the gate itself.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
Compute |mean cross-sectional corr| of score vs existing factors (covariates via load_month_factors), target |corr| low to claim a new channel:
  - vs Net Payout Yield / DividendToAssets / PayoutRatio (DART fundamentals): TARGET |corr|<0.35. RISK of overlap: buyback firms ARE high-payout firms, so the SHAREHOLDER-RETURN axis may already be priced — this is the single most important orthogonality check (if score just proxies net-payout-yield, it is not novel). Measure and report explicitly.
  - vs C23_OtherCorp OtherCorp_NetBuy_Accumulation (the sibling): TARGET |corr|<0.30. They share the 자사주/insider-conviction lineage but C27 is the structured DECISION event (board resolution) while C23 is settled OtherCorp trading flow — should be distinct timing. Confirm they are not the same signal arriving via two channels.
  - vs Value (BM/EP), Momentum (12-1), Quality (GPA/PiotroskiF), Size, INV01-13 (Foreign/Inst/Individual flow): TARGET |corr|<0.30 each. Buyback intensity should be largely orthogonal to price-momentum and to investor-type flow.
  - vs Insider net-buy (dart_insider_signal): TARGET |corr|<0.40 — related conviction family (corporate vs personal insider); expect modest positive.
Report the max |mean_corr| and name the binding factor. The novelty claim (proposer novelty=5) stands only if max|corr| (esp. vs net-payout-yield) is below ~0.4; otherwise downgrade to 'payout-axis refinement'.
build_steps: 1. WRITE collector 02_Infrastructure/data/data_collector_dart_buyback.R: dart_fetch_buyback(years=2015:2026) — list.json (pblntf_ty I+B, report_nm regex '자기주식.*취득.*결정') paginated -> per-rcept_no tsstkAqDecsn.json detail -> persist columns (rcept_no, corp_code, aqpln_stk_ostk/estk, aqpln_prc_ostk/estk, aq_mth, aq_pp_bgn/end_de) to .cache/dart/buyback_decisions.parquet via temp-rename (arrow mmap 1224 guard). Reuse corpcode_map.parquet, .load_dart_key, 0.7s delay, resume/checkpoint pattern from data_collector_dart_insider.R.
2. RUN collection (background, multi-hour — DART rate limit). Verify coverage: events/month time series, event-firm count distribution, pre-2015 thinness. Label data floor.

3. WRITE fe_buyback_drift.R (mirror fe_disclosure_meta.R skeleton): load buyback_decisions.parquet; rcept_date=substr(rcept_no,1,8); Usable_Date=next_tday(rcept_date); build monthly .MEND grid; for each t compute event_active (within DRIFT_M window), intensity=ln(1+planned_amount/Size_{t-1}) with amount/股수/Close fallbacks, method_mult, freshness_decay; merge K200∪KQ150 membership + LiqPass(t-1 ADV); emit scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score). Embed the C14 max(Usable_Date)<=Date stop() assertion.
4. BUILD returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m) forward 1M realized + bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) from RAWDATA, PIT-aligned (Ret_1m is forward, scores are at t).
5. RUN canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, liq_dt=ADV). Capture portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, net_sr, IR, turnover, period_returns. PRIMARY config first.
6. RUN top_concentration_test (5 sub-tests: full decile profile, D10 t-stat, D10-D9 gap, event-vs-market, Size>median robustness). This is the make-or-break evidence vs the C23 flat-top failure.
7. RUN lookback_grid (576 cells) for robustness surface: % cells port_t>0, primary cell rank. selection_type='chain', DSR diagnostic-only.
8. RUN orthogonality: max|mean_corr| vs net-payout-yield (binding risk), C23, Value/Mom/Quality/Size/INV/insider. Confirm novelty or downgrade.

9. IF primary port_t>=2.95 & oos_retention>=0.7 & calmar>=0.64 & D10-concentrated -> graduation candidate -> handoff to forge build_bt_result for authoritative weights. ELSE -> screen_route (DPL_FEATURE / FR-RCMA input) per measurement-graduation 2-tier, report as clean negative with the specific failure mechanism.
10. EMIT alpha_package.json with metric_type labels, pit_c15_exception=documented_spec_sanctioned, method_shopping_log selection_type='chain', honest decile + orthogonality numbers.
specs.honest_risks:
PRIMARY FAILURE MODE — top still flat despite binary gate: the sibling C23_OtherCorp (same buyback/Ikenberry lineage) had rank-IC 0.020/harvey 3.38 but port_t −0.52 with ALL 27 grid cells negative because the top decile was flat. The binary event gate is designed to defeat this, but it can still fail if KR buyback drift is (a) already priced by announcement day (efficient w.r.t. a salient, mandatory disclosure) so the post-Usable_Date drift is ~0, or (b) concentrated in firms that simultaneously have poor momentum/quality (value-trap buybacks), making the net-active flat. MUST report event-vs-market test (sub-test 4) — if even all-event-firms-EW is flat, the catalyst has no KR drift, full stop.

NET-PAYOUT REDUNDANCY: buyback firms are high-shareholder-return firms; if score correlates >0.5 with net-payout-yield, this is not a novel channel but a payout-axis refinement (existing Net Payout Yield strategy already in registry). Novelty=5 claim is conditional on the orthogonality test.

EVENT THINNESS / breadth collapse: pre-2023 KR buyback decisions may yield <20 active event firms/month, forcing sub-top_n concentration (held-count variance) and making early-period port_t noisy. The Value-up surge (2023+) is well-populated but is a SHORT, possibly regime-specific sample — risk that the entire edge is a 2023-26 phenomenon that won't survive oos_retention (anchored 55/65/75 split). Report the subperiod era breakdown like C23 did.

SMALL-CAP / LIQUIDITY ARTIFACT: KR buyback-announcing firms skew small/mid; a raw D10 outperformance could be a micro-cap premium, not a buyback effect. Sub-test 5 (Size>median) and the t-1 ADV>=2e8 gate guard this; if D10 port_t collapses in liquid names, the signal is untradeable.

TRUST vs DIRECT mis-weighting: 신탁계약(trust) buybacks have weaker mechanical demand and are sometimes never fully executed; the method_mult=0.6 is a prior, not measured — if data shows trust buybacks have ZERO drift, direct-only (method_mult [1,0]) is the real signal and the trust mass is pure noise diluting the portfolio.

COLLECTION RISK (feasibility=3): tsstkAqDecsn requires a new multi-hour DART crawl with no cached table; rate limits, the Windows arrow mmap 1224 bug, and amount-field parsing (won vs 천원 unit ambiguity in older filings) can corrupt intensity. Validate planned_amount/Size distribution (should be ~0.5%-15% of mktcap; values >50% or <0.01% flag parse errors) before trusting the signal.

specs.name: M_BuybackDrift_Confirmed
specs.construction:
CRITICAL DATA RESHAPE vs the concept brief. .cache/stock_buyback.parquet is NOT a discrete-event log; it is a QUARTERLY PANEL (302,051 rows, 3,558 tickers, 2000Q1-2025Q4): one row per (Ticker, quarter), Item='SBB' only, Value = treasury-stock/buyback KRW notional for that quarter (median 0; ~7.1% rows nonzero; nonzero median 8.7e4, p99 5.55e6, max 2e8). Factor_Date = Period_Date + exactly 45 days (uniform, C4-clean). So the C27 'flat baseline -> D10 spike' framing must be reframed: there is no binary event flag; the alpha is the CROSS-SECTIONAL BUYBACK-YIELD RANK carried across the 3 months of each quarter under PIT.

SIGNAL (per rebalance month t, sig_date = last trading day of month t):
Step A buyback yield (scale-free; raw KRW Value is a size proxy, MUST normalize). Take buyback quarters q with Factor_Date <= sig_date(t). Use TTM = sum of Value over the 4 most recent such quarters to denoise lumpy single filings: SBB_ttm_i. BuybackYield_i = SBB_ttm_i / MktCap_i, MktCap_i = RAWDATA.Size at sig_date (KRW market cap). Clip to [0,0.5]. SBB_ttm<=0 -> yield 0.
Step B momentum confirmation (precision lever, filters value-trap buybacks): M03_i = Close_i(t)/Close_i(t-3m)-1 from monthly-resampled RAWDATA Close, prices up to sig_date only. med = cross-sectional median M03 over eligible universe; confirm_i = 1 if M03_i > med else 0.
Step C confirmed score: score_i = BuybackYield_i * confirm_i (hard gate: buyback yield counts only if momentum is upper-half). Tie-break/secondary variant for ablation: score_soft_i = rank(BuybackYield_i) * (0.5 + 0.5*confirm_i).
Step D universe filter then top-25 EW long-only via canonical_screen_bt. Eligible = (K200==1 OR KQ150==1) at sig_date AND AdminStock==0 AND TradingHalt==0 AND UnfaithfulDisc==0 AND adv(t-1) >= 2e8. Select 25 highest score; if fewer than 25 have score>0 (confirm gate thins the pool), fill remaining slots from highest BuybackYield ignoring the gate, flagged, to keep N=25 (honest_risks tracks how often this triggers).
build_steps: 1. Load .cache/stock_buyback.parquet -> dt_sbb(Ticker, Period, Value, Factor_Date). Drop the 8 negative-Value rows (data noise) or floor at 0.

2. Build TTM buyback: for each (Ticker, quarter) compute rolling 4-quarter trailing sum of Value ordered by Period; attach its Factor_Date (the latest of the 4). This is the as-of-disclosure TTM buyback.

3. Load RAWDATA.parquet columns Date,Ticker,K200,KQ150,Close,Vol,Size,Ret,BM_Ret,AdminStock,TradingHalt,UnfaithfulDisc. Resample to monthly (last trading day): Close_m, Size_m, univ flags, plus adv = 20d mean(Vol*Close) lagged to t-1.
4. Compute M03_i per month from monthly Close (3-month look-back); compute cross-sectional median per month; confirm flag.

5. PIT join: for each month t, asof-merge each Ticker's latest TTM buyback row where Factor_Date <= sig_date(t) (data.table roll-forward / asof). Compute BuybackYield = SBB_ttm / Size_m, clip [0,0.5].
6. score = BuybackYield * confirm. Restrict to eligible universe (K200|KQ150, clean flags, adv>=2e8).

7. Assemble scores_dt(Date, Ticker, score); returns_dt(Date, Ticker, Ret_1m = forward 1M realized from monthly Ret compounding, PIT-aligned forward); bench_dt(Date, BM_Ret); liq_dt(Date, Ticker, adv).
8. Call canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=25L, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8). Read portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, information_ratio, net_sr, turnover_annual.
9. Run the decile diagnostic (top_concentration_test) on the SAME scores_dt to confirm monotonicity and that D10 carries the alpha.
10. Run orthogonality regression of the net active series vs incumbent factor returns (kr_factor_returns_v2.parquet) and vs a plain size/value screen.
11. Ablation A/B: (i) buyback yield WITHOUT confirm gate, (ii) WITH gate, (iii) raw KRW Value (un-normalized) to prove normalization matters, (iv) confirm gate with M06/M12 instead of M03.
specs.top_concentration_test: Goal: verify the EXTREME top of the buyback-yield-confirmed score earns real net active return, not a flat/short tail (the dominant failure mode for KR long-only). Procedure on the full PIT panel: (1) Each month t, restrict to eligible universe, drop score==0 names (confirm gate / no buyback) BEFORE ranking so deciles are over the ACTIVE-signal subset; record n_active(t). Form value-weighted-by-equal deciles D1..D10 of score (D10 = highest buyback-yield-confirmed). (2) For each decile compute forward 1M EW net return (15bps applied on monthly turnover) and the active series (decile - BM_Ret). (3) Report the decile profile: mean monthly active, annualized active, and hit-rate per Dk; the signal is validated only if the profile is MONOTONE rising D1->D10 (not a single-bucket artifact). (4) D10 t-stat: NW lag-3 t-stat of the D10 net-active series (reuse build_benchmark_compare on the D10-as-portfolio vs BM, read Portfolio_Alpha_t_NW_lag3). Require >= 2.0 as a screening signal, with the 25-name canonical_screen_bt PORT_t being the binding number. (5) D10-D9 gap: long-short D10 minus D9 active series; NW t-stat of the gap; a positive significant gap proves the EXTREME top adds beyond merely-high — i.e. concentration is the lever, not just broad exposure. (6) Concentration robustness: also run top-15 and top-25 canonical_screen_bt; if top-15 PORT_t > top-25 PORT_t the concentration thesis holds; if it decays, the top is diluting and flag as concentration-fragile. (7) Spike-survival check specific to this quarterly carry: split D10 months into 'fresh-disclosure month' (the month right after a name's Factor_Date) vs 'carry months 2-3'; if active is concentrated only in the fresh month and flat/negative in carry months, the alpha is a disclosure-drift pop that the monthly carry dilutes -> reduce holding or trade only fresh-disclosure cohort.
specs.estimator: Non-parametric cross-sectional rank + hard momentum gate, then equal-weight top-25 (canonical_screen_bt). No fitted parameters in the base spec (gate threshold = cross-sectional median, fixed; TTM window = 4 quarters, fixed) -> this is a hypothesis-driven SINGLE alpha (n_trials ~ 1), so DSR gate does NOT apply (selection_type='single' / 'chain'); overfit defense = oos_retention>=0.7 + holdout falsification. Performance estimation strictly via canonical_screen_bt -> build_benchmark_compare (NW lag-3 portfolio-alpha t, IR, net SR); NO proxy hand-computation, NO prod(1+r)/cumprod self-synthesis. Decile diagnostic uses the same contract function on each decile-as-portfolio. The A/B ablations (with/without gate, M03 vs M06/M12, normalized vs raw) are DIAGNOSTIC variants reported alongside, IS-only selection, not a sweep that picks the winner for graduation.
specs.lookback_grid: TTM buyback window: {2Q, 4Q (base), 8Q} -- shorter = fresher signal but lumpier; longer = smoother but staler. Momentum confirmation horizon: M03 (base, per concept) with diagnostic alternates {M06, M12} -- M03 is the thinnest/freshest, risk of over-thinning the spike. Top-N concentration: {15, 25 (base)} -- 25 is the mandate hard cap; 15 tests whether the extreme top is stronger. Rebalance: monthly (carry quarterly buyback across 3 months). Buyback-yield clip: [0,0.5] fixed. Period coverage: full 2005-01..2026-02 (buyback Factor_Date starts 2000-05, RAWDATA from 1990; start at 2005 per alpha-search universe convention). IS/OOS split for oos_retention v2 = anchored {55/65/75} median per measurement-graduation C1.
specs.data_inputs: .cache/stock_buyback.parquet: Ticker(str A-prefixed), Period(str YYYYQQ-end e.g. 200312), Item(='SBB' const), Value(double, buyback KRW notional, quarterly; 8 negatives to floor), Period_Date(date, quarter-end), Factor_Date(date = Period_Date+45d, PIT disclosure). .cache/RAWDATA.parquet: Date, Ticker, K200(0/1 PIT membership), KQ150(0/1), Close, Vol, Size(market cap KRW, median 7.7e10), Ret, BM_Ret(KOSPI200 TR), AdminStock, TradingHalt, UnfaithfulDisc, Sector. Liquidity adv = 20d mean(Vol*Close) (median ~5.3e8 at recent date, threshold 2e8). Orthogonality reference: .cache/kr_factor_returns_v2.parquet (incumbent factor return series) + an internal plain BuybackYield-WITHOUT-confirm screen and a size/value screen. NOT USED (avoid scope creep / redundancy): shares_issued.parquet (alternative normalizer; Size is the cleaner cap denominator), QuantiWise consensus (would re-introduce momentum overlap). No cross-market / alt-data.
specs.orthogonality_targets: Primary concern (per concept's own redundancy warning): the M03 confirm gate re-introduces a price-momentum element overlapping the M* family. Targets on the NET ACTIVE series correlation: vs M* momentum factors (M03/M06/M12 momentum, kr_factor_returns_v2) |corr| <= 0.40 (active basis, not gross -- gross will read ~0.7+ from shared market beta per measurement-graduation §6; report active -BM correlation as binding). vs value/EP family |corr| <= 0.35 (buyback firms skew value -> must prove the alpha is buyback-specific not value-beta). vs size factor |corr| <= 0.35 (Size-normalization should already neutralize, verify). vs a plain BuybackYield-WITHOUT-confirm screen: corr will be high by design (~0.7-0.9); the test is incremental -- the confirmed variant must show HIGHER PORT_t and HIGHER IR than the unconfirmed, else the gate adds nothing and should be dropped. Stretch: book-marginal vs incumbent book (STR_1715) ΔIR >= 0.05 with |corr| < 0.30 for any admission consideration (governor manual, not this spec's job).
specs.pit_notes: C1 (no full-sample stat): all cross-sectional medians (M03 gate), ranks, and clips computed per-month from that month's cross-section only; no pooled normalization. C2 (no same-day circular): score at sig_date(t) maps to FORWARD Ret_1m (month t+1); returns_dt carries forward realized return, never same-month. C4 (financial lag): SATISFIED STRUCTURALLY -- buyback Factor_Date = Period_Date + 45 days (verified uniform), and we asof-join only rows with Factor_Date <= sig_date(t), so a quarter's buyback enters the signal no earlier than 45 days after quarter-end (matches the quarterly-disclosure 45-day rule). C5/C8 (overlay/weight same-day): no overlay; weights are mechanical EW top-25 at t. C6 (survivorship): RAWDATA membership flags K200/KQ150 are point-in-time per Date -> delisted/exited names are excluded only as of their actual exit, not retroactively; buyback panel includes 3,558 tickers incl. dead names. C10 (liquidity t-1): adv uses 20d mean(Vol*Close) lagged to t-1, passed via liq_dt to canonical_screen_bt. C13 (no sign-flip): BuybackYield is naturally signed (higher buyback = higher score), no NEGATE/FLIP. C14 (Usable_Date <= sig_date): enforced by the Factor_Date <= sig_date asof filter. C15 (no direct factor-DB parquet bypass): N/A -- this is a NEW raw signal built from stock_buyback + RAWDATA, not a Factor DB factor; no load_month_factors path exists for it, which is permitted for new-signal construction. Carry-forward caveat: a buyback quarter is reused for up to 3 months until the next quarter's Factor_Date clears -> always the LATEST disclosed, never a future quarter.
specs.honest_risks: 1. TOP-GOES-FLAT (the heaviest risk, exactly the concept's stated worry): KR buybacks are often defensive/signaling by mature value names; even after the M03 gate the top-25 may be value-trap survivors whose forward return is flat -> PORT_t < 2.0. The decile test's D10-D9 gap and spike-survival split are the early detectors. 2. GATE OVER-THINNING: confirm gate requires both buyback>0 AND M03>median; in some months <25 names pass -> spec falls back to ungated fill, contaminating purity. Must report fill-frequency; if frequent, the 'confirmed' label is diluted. 3. MOMENTUM REDUNDANCY: the gate may simply tilt toward names already moving -> active corr with M* > 0.40, in which case the alpha is repackaged momentum (mild-redundancy risk the concept flagged); orthogonality test is the kill-switch. 4. QUARTERLY-CARRY DILUTION: monthly rebal carries a quarterly signal 3 months; if the buyback-announcement drift decays within ~1 month, carry months 2-3 add turnover/cost with no edge -> net SR hit; spike-survival split quantifies. 5. SIZE-NORMALIZATION ARTIFACT: SBB/Size could just re-rank toward small caps with lumpy buybacks; the clip [0,0.5] and the adv>=2e8 liquidity filter mitigate but verify the top-25 isn't a micro-cap basket. 6. SPARSE-EVENT NOISE: only ~7% of firm-quarters nonzero; TTM helps but the effective cross-section of buyback names per month (~137-250 in 2020+) is fine, EXCEPT early sample (2005-2008) may be thinner -> check n_active(t) floor. 7. DATA: 8 negative Value rows (likely treasury-stock disposals) -- floored to 0; if disposals are actually a bearish signal we discard information (acceptable for a long-only buyback-accumulation thesis). 8. cost_model_version is delta-based 15bps one-way; quarterly carry keeps turnover moderate but the gate flipping names month-to-month could spike turnover -> watch turnover_annual <= ~11x.

specs.name: C29_Index_Inclusion_Frontrun_Drift
specs.construction:
정확 신호식 (continuous freshness-decay × passive-demand footprint, long-only score):

목표 = 인덱스(K200/KQ150) 신규편입 종목의 "강제 패시브 매수 → 가격압력 드리프트"를 포착. 이벤트가 sparse(~14-20/yr)하므로 binary D10 지표는 비-이벤트월에 top-20을 비워 canonical_screen_bt(연속 score로 top_n 채움)와 비호환. 따라서 **연속 freshness-decay 스코어**로 변환해 비-이벤트월에도 "최근 편입 종목"이 top을 채우되, 갓 편입된 종목에 극단 score가 집중되도록 설계.

(1) 편입 이벤트 일자 (PIT-안전):
  flag(i,m) = K200 또는 KQ150 멤버십 (월말 패널, EFFECTIVE date). 
  incl_event(i,m) = 1  iff  flag(i,m)==1 AND flag(i,m-1)==0   (0→1 전이)
  ★PIT 핵심: 패널 flag는 EFFECTIVE 월에 켜짐. KR(KRX)은 정기변경을 효력 ~2-4주 전 사전공시하나, 패널엔 effective-date만 있음 → **announce_date를 effective 월말 −1개월(보수적 1M lag)로 가정**해 sig_date = effective 월말 직전 거래일 기준으로만 score 평가(아래 pit_notes C2/C5). 즉 "편입 알려진 시점"을 effective −21영업일로 정의.

(2) freshness 시계 (age, 월 단위):
  age(i,m) = m − (i의 최근 incl_event 월).  age=0 = 막 편입(effective 월). age>0 = 편입 후 경과월.
  관측창: age ∈ [A_lag, A_max]. A_lag = pre-announce를 흡수하기 위한 진입 lag(아래 grid). A_max = 드리프트 소멸 horizon.

(3) passive-demand footprint 가중 (index-weight scaling, RAWDATA Size):
  편입 시점 패시브 수요 ≈ 인덱스 내 신규 비중. 절대 비중이 클수록(=대형주) 강제매수 명목 ↑ 그러나 ADV 대비 충격은 ↓. 두 효과를 분리:
    w_idx(i) = Size(i) / Σ_{j∈index,m} Size(j)         # 편입월 인덱스 내 신규 비중(패시브 수요 명목 비례)
    impact_proxy(i) = w_idx(i) × AUM_const / ADV_21(i)   # 명목수요 / 21d 평균 거래대금 = 충격 강도(Size 큰 종목은 ADV도 커서 자연 정규화)
    AUM_const = 상수(패시브 AUM 가정, 횡단면 monotone 변환이라 값 무관 — rank만 사용).
  → footprint(i) = z_xs( log(impact_proxy(i)) )         # 횡단면 z-score. "충격이 큰 편입"일수록 높음.

(4) 최종 연속 score (sig_date 기준):
  decay(age) = exp( −age / τ )                            # τ = 반감 horizon(월), grid
  score(i,m) = decay(age(i,m)) × ( 1 + λ × footprint(i) ) × eligible(i,m)
    eligible(i,m) = 1 iff age ∈ [A_lag, A_max] AND 종목 KR 유니버스(K200∪KQ150) AND not AdminStock/TradingHalt/UnfaithfulDisc(RAWDATA 플래그)
    λ = footprint 가중치(grid). λ=0이면 순수 freshness, λ>0이면 high-impact 편입 우대.
  비-eligible 종목 score=NA → canonical_screen_bt가 자동 제외. eligible 종목만 score 보유 → top_n EW는 "가장 최근·고충격 편입" 종목으로 채워짐.

직관: D10 = age 작고 footprint 큰 종목(갓 편입 + 충격 큰). score가 연속이라 top-N 항상 채워지되, 이벤트 직후 월엔 신규편입군이 top을 지배, 이벤트 공백기엔 직전 편입 잔여군이 decay된 채 잔류(holding-extended sleeve 성격).
specs.construction_note: long-only ONLY (AX-007 buy-side escape — 편입은 매수압력이라 long leg만 경제적 의미). 공매도/short leg 없음. λ·τ·A_lag·A_max는 IS-only로 선택(chain 자격), DSR 게이트는 sweep 아니면 면제(measurement-graduation §3).
specs.estimator:
신호 = 비-파라메트릭 결정식 (decay × footprint), 추정 파라미터 없음(τ/λ/A_lag/A_max는 hyperparameter grid, 학습계수 아님). 

성과 추정기 = canonical_screen_bt() (02_Infrastructure/contracts/canonical_screen_bt.R):
- top_n EW long-only, 15bps one-way(delta-based traded notional), 유동성필터 adv≥2e8.
- portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (NW lag-3, build_benchmark_compare 경유) = 권위 screening 수치.
- net_sr, information_ratio, alpha_annualized, turnover_annual 동시 산출.
- metric_type="canonical_screen" (admission binding 아님 — forge build_bt_result가 authoritative).

decile profiling 추정기 = 횡단면 score 10분위 panel-OLS:
- 각 month m에서 eligible∪non-eligible 전 유니버스에 score 부여(non-eligible=0 floor), 10분위 분할 후 분위별 forward 1M EW active return(−BM).
- D10 t-stat = NW(lag-3) t of D10 active return 시계열. D10−D9 gap = 두 분위 active 시계열 차의 평균/NW-SE.
specs.lookback_grid:
진입 lag A_lag (effective 월말 기준 추가 보유 시작 시점):
  A_lag ∈ {0, 1} 개월. A_lag=1 = effective 후 1개월부터 보유(pre-announce 프론트런 구간을 PIT-안전하게 배제 — 우선 conservative). A_lag=0 = effective 월부터(announce가 effective −1M에 알려졌다는 가정 하 진입; PIT-borderline, sensitivity로만).
관측 horizon A_max ∈ {3, 6, 9, 12} 개월 (편입효과 드리프트 소멸 horizon. 문헌 index effect는 3-12M).
decay τ ∈ {2, 4, 6} 개월 (반감기. τ→∞면 horizon 내 flat weight).
footprint 가중 λ ∈ {0, 0.5, 1.0} (0=순수 freshness baseline, >0=고충격 편입 우대).
ADV 윈도우 = 21영업일(고정), Size = 편입 sig_date 직전 거래일(고정).
유니버스 분리 sensitivity: {K200-only, KQ150-only, K200∪KQ150} (KQ150은 2010+만 가용 — K200 단독이 main, 통합은 2010+ 부분기간).
★grid 선택은 IS-only(2005-2016 K200), holdout(2017+)은 최종 1안만 1회 — chain 자격(measurement-graduation §3). n_trials 기록: 2(A_lag)×4(A_max)×3(τ)×3(λ)=72 config는 sweep이므로 selection_type="sweep" → DSR≥0.5 HARD 적용. (가설주도 chain 아님 — 명시적 grid이므로 정직하게 sweep 분류.)
specs.data_inputs:
인덱스 멤버십 (이벤트 dating):
- .cache/universe_support/us_k200.parquet : cols [Date(월말 object), Ticker, K200(0/1 float)] — 436 월, 1990-01~2026-03, 640 0→1 전이.
- .cache/universe_support/us_kq150.parquet : cols [Date, Ticker, KQ150] — 2010-01~ (이전 NaN), 342 0→1 전이.
- (RAWDATA에도 K200/KQ150 컬럼 동봉 — 일간. 멤버십 전이 dating은 월말 패널 사용, 일간은 cross-check용.)

가격·footprint (.cache/RAWDATA.parquet, 일간 8971일, 1990-01~2026-06, cols 검증됨):
- Size : 시가총액(KRW 천원, 편입월 인덱스 비중 w_idx 및 impact_proxy 분모 정규화).
- Vol, Close : ADV_21 = rolling 21d mean(Close×Vol 또는 거래대금) — impact_proxy 분모 + 유동성필터(2e8).
- Ret : 일간 수익 → forward 1M(Ret_1m) 구성 (월말 다음달 누적, PerformanceAnalytics/표준 경유 — 자체합성 금지).
- AdminStock, TradingHalt, UnfaithfulDisc : eligible 게이트(관리/거래정지/불성실공시 제외).
- BM_Ret : KOSPI200 total-return 벤치(bench_dt의 BM_Ret).
- Sector / Sector_Lv2 : orthogonality 진단(섹터 중립 잔차) + 편입군 섹터 쏠림 점검.

DART (보강·선택): 자사주매입/대량보유 변동 공시는 본 알파엔 미사용(편입 이벤트가 1차 catalyst). 단 footprint 검증 시 편입 전후 기관 순매수(QuantiWise 투자자유형)로 패시브 수요 실재 cross-check 가능(선택).

캐시: scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score) + returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m forward) + bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) + liq_dt(Date,Ticker,adv) 4-테이블을 canonical_screen_bt에 전달.
specs.pit_notes:
C1 (full-sample 금지): footprint z-score는 각 편입월 횡단면(cross-sectional) z — full-sample 표준화 아님. τ/λ/A_max grid는 IS구간(2005-2016)에서만 선택, holdout(2017+) 미조회 → expanding/holdout 분리. impact_proxy의 AUM_const는 상수(rank monotone)라 미래정보 무관.

C2/C5 (same-day / overlay t-1) — ★본 알파의 1차 PIT 리스크(rationale 페널티 1):
- 멤버십 패널 flag는 EFFECTIVE 월말에 켜짐. effective 월 수익을 score에 쓰면 "편입 확정일 = 가격반영일" 순환참조(C2). 
- 방어: incl_event(0→1) 감지 후 **score는 effective 월말 sig_date 기준으로만 평가, forward 수익은 다음 달부터**. 추가로 A_lag=1(effective +1M부터 보유)을 main config로 채택 → pre-announce 프론트런 구간 자체를 PIT-안전하게 배제(보수적). announce_date를 effective −21영업일로 가정하는 A_lag=0은 sensitivity-only, 판정엔 미사용.
- overlay/이벤트 신호는 t−1 (C5): score(i,m)은 m−1까지 알 수 있는 멤버십·Size·ADV만 사용. m월 Size/ADV는 m−1 말 값.

C3 (같은기간 집계→적용 금지): w_idx 분모 Σ Size는 편입 sig_date 시점 횡단면 합 — 미래 인덱스 구성 미사용.

C4 (재무 lag): 재무제표 미사용(가격·멤버십·Size만) → C4 N/A.

C6 (survivorship): 멤버십 패널은 PIT 시점 구성(편입/편출 모두 기록, 436개월 전이 추적). 편출(1→0)된 종목도 패널에 0으로 잔류 → 생존편향 없음. 상장폐지/거래정지는 AdminStock/TradingHalt 게이트로 eligible 제외(미래 폐지정보 아닌 당시 상태).

C7 (lookahead_detector): score 구성 후 lookahead_detector.R 통과 의무.

C9 (DD/VT same-day): 오버레이 미적용 → N/A.

C10 (유동성 t-1): liq_dt의 adv = t−1 기준 21d 평균 거래대금. canonical_screen_bt liq_min=2e8.

C13 (NEGATE/FLIP 금지): score는 항상 ≥0 방향(편입=매수압력=positive). sign flip 없음. decay·footprint 모두 monotone 양(+).

C14 (IC Usable_Date ≤ sig_date): decile IC 산출 시 score의 Usable_Date(멤버십·Size·ADV 관측가능일) ≤ sig_date 검증.

C15 (Factor DB 경유): 본 알파는 Factor DB 팩터 미사용(RAWDATA 가격 + 멤버십 패널 직접). RAWDATA/membership parquet는 C15 carve-out(가격·멤버십 raw, factor DB 아님) — load_month_factors 불요. 단 PIT-aligned merge는 호출자 책임(canonical_screen_bt 주석 명시).

핵심 잔여 리스크 라벨: A_lag=0 config는 "PIT-borderline(announce 가정)"으로 명시, 판정 수치는 A_lag=1만 인용. 효력일만 있는 패널의 한계 = honest_risks에 기재.
specs.top_concentration_test:
목적: 극단 top(D10 = 갓편입+고충격)이 실제 net active 초과수익인지, 아니면 결국 flat(드리프트 소멸)/역전(편입 후 mean-reversion)인지 검증. rationale의 D1-D9 structural-zero / D10 catalyst 구조를 실측.

(1) decile panel 구성:
- 각 월 m에서 전 유니버스(K200∪KQ150)에 score 부여: eligible 종목 = 연속 score, non-eligible = 0(structural floor). 
- score>0 종목만으로 10분위 분할이면 D1-D9가 비어 무의미 → 대신 **전 유니버스 횡단면 10분위**(score=0 대량이 하위 분위 채움). D10 = score 최상위 10%(=최근·고충격 편입군), D1-D5 ≈ score=0 bulk(비편입), D6-D9 = 잔여 decay 중간군.
- 분위별 forward 1M EW active return(ri − BM) 시계열 산출(2005-2026 월간).

(2) D10 t-stat 측정:
- D10 active 시계열에 NW(lag-3) t — canonical_screen_bt와 동일 build_benchmark_compare 엔진으로 D10-only top-N(=top decile EW) 백테 후 portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 추출. HARD 기준 참고: graduation은 2.95(measurement-graduation §3 HARD), screening 통과는 t>0 유의.
- 추가: D10 평균 active, 승률(positive month %), 편입 후 age별 평균 active(age=0,1,2,...A_max) — 드리프트가 어느 age에서 발생/소멸하는지 term-structure.

(3) D10−D9 gap 측정 (극단성 검정):
- (D10 active − D9 active) 시계열의 평균 / NW-SE → gap t-stat. gap이 유의(+)면 "최상위 편입군만의 초과수익"(극단 집중 실재). gap≈0이면 효과가 D9까지 분산(top-concentration 약함, 연속 score가 평탄).
- monotonicity: D1<...<D10 단조성 Spearman(분위 index vs 평균 active). 단조 양(+)이 이상적.

(4) 극단성 robustness:
- placebo: incl_event 월을 ±1~3개월 무작위 shift한 가짜 편입일로 동일 score → D10 t가 0으로 붕괴해야 진짜(편입 catalyst가 원천임을 입증). p<0.05.
- footprint ablation: λ=0(순수 freshness) vs λ=1(footprint 가중) D10 t 비교 — footprint scaling이 D10 집중을 강화하는지.
- age-conditional: age=0~2(fresh) D10 t vs age=3~A_max(stale) D10 t — 드리프트가 fresh에 집중되면 top-concentration mechanism 확증.

판정: D10 t_NW(lag3) > 0 유의 AND D10−D9 gap t > 0 AND placebo 붕괴 → top-concentration 실재. D10이 flat/음수거나 gap≈0이면 honest_risks의 "결국 flat" 실현 → DPL feature/screen_route 강등.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
기존 KR 팩터 대비 직교성 (active-basis 상관, measurement-graduation §6 — gross 아닌 active(−BM) 기준):

1. 모멘텀(M05/M32 Composite_Mom, R-15 등): 편입 종목은 편입 전 강세(편입 자체가 시총 성장 결과)라 momentum과 양의 노출 우려. **목표 |corr_active| < 0.35**. 초과 시 momentum-residualize(FWL: score를 momentum에 회귀한 잔차) 옵션. ★1차 직교 타깃 — 편입 catalyst가 단순 모멘텀 재포장이 아님을 입증해야 novelty=5 성립.

2. Size/시총(RAWDATA Size, SMB): footprint가 Size 함수라 size 노출 위험. impact_proxy를 ADV로 정규화해 순수 size-tilt 완화했으나 잔존 가능. **목표 |corr_active| < 0.30**. size-neutral 잔차 sensitivity.

3. 단기 reversal(ST_REV, 1M): 편입 직후 가격압력 후 reversal 가능 → 음의 상관 예상. **목표 |corr_active| < 0.30** (음의 상관이면 오히려 보완적).

4. 유동성/회전율(Amihud, turnover): impact_proxy ADV 정규화로 유동성 팩터와 중첩 가능. **목표 |corr_active| < 0.30**.

5. 변동성/저베타(BAB, D-vol): 편입군은 대형·저변동 편향 가능. **목표 |corr_active| < 0.30**.

측정법: 각 기존 팩터의 동일 top-N canonical_screen_bt active 시계열과 본 알파 active 시계열의 Pearson corr (267월 _ortho_audit 패턴). gross 상관도 병기하되 판정은 active 기준(§6: gross는 시장β≈0.99 공유분 과대평가).

목표 종합: momentum 외 전 팩터 |corr_active|<0.30, momentum<0.35. 충족 시 "잔차-직교 sleeve"로 RAMP/FR 소비 후보(단 PORT_t 통과 동시 충족분만 book 실질 기여 — §6).
build_steps: 1. 멤버십 이벤트 dating: us_k200.parquet + us_kq150.parquet 로드 → Date를 월말 datetime 변환 → Ticker별 정렬 후 K200/KQ150 0→1 전이(incl_event) 감지 → 종목별 최근 편입월 테이블 incl_month(i) 생성. KQ150는 2010+만, K200은 2001+(메인 2005+).
2. age 패널: 각 월 m × eligible 종목에 age(i,m)=m−incl_month(i) 계산. eligible = age∈[A_lag,A_max] AND not (AdminStock/TradingHalt/UnfaithfulDisc) AND K200∪KQ150 멤버. RAWDATA 일간 → 월말 스냅으로 플래그·Size·ADV 추출.

3. footprint: 편입 sig_date(effective 월말 직전거래일) 시점 Size로 w_idx(i)=Size_i/Σ_{index}Size, ADV_21=rolling21d mean(Close×Vol), impact_proxy=w_idx×AUM_const/ADV_21 → 횡단면 log z-score = footprint(i). (AUM_const 상수, rank monotone.)
4. score 조립: score(i,m)=exp(−age/τ)×(1+λ×footprint)×eligible. non-eligible NA. scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score) 캐시(월말 sig_date 기준, m−1 관측치만 사용 — C5/C10).
5. forward 수익·벤치·유동성 테이블: RAWDATA 일간 Ret → 월말 다음달 forward 1M(Ret_1m) 구성(표준 함수, 자체합성 금지). returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m) + bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) + liq_dt(Date,Ticker,adv=t-1 21d 거래대금).
6. PIT 게이트: lookahead_detector.R + bear_date_audit 류 통과. A_lag=1 main(effective+1M 진입), A_lag=0 borderline-sensitivity 라벨. C2/C5/C10/C14 명시 검증.

7. IS grid 탐색(2005-2016 K200): 72 config(A_lag×A_max×τ×λ)를 canonical_screen_bt(top_n=20,25)로 실측 → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3·net_sr·turnover IS 최적 1안 선택. selection_type='sweep' → DSR≥0.5 HARD 적용(72 trials 기록).
8. decile profiling: 전 유니버스 10분위 → D1..D10 active term-structure + D10 t_NW(lag3) + D10−D9 gap t + monotonicity Spearman (top_concentration_test 절차).
9. orthogonality: momentum/size/reversal/liquidity/lowvol 각 canonical active 시계열과 corr_active 측정(목표 <0.30, momentum<0.35). 초과 시 FWL residualize sensitivity.

10. holdout 1회(2017+): IS 선택 1안만 canonical_screen_bt 실측 → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3·oos_retention·calmar 보고. placebo(±1~3M shift) + footprint ablation robustness. metric_type='canonical_screen' 라벨, admission 아님(forge 이행 시 build_bt_result).

11. 판정·라우팅: D10 t>0 유의 ∧ gap>0 ∧ placebo 붕괴 ∧ ortho 충족 → screen_pass. graduation HARD(PORT_t 2.95·oos 0.7·calmar 0.64) 미달이어도 sparse-sleeve 특성상 OVERLAY_CANDIDATE 또는 FR_RCMA(국면 specialist) 또는 DPL_FEATURE로 screen_route. flat/음수면 honest_risks 실현 → DPL feature 강등.
specs.honest_risks:
1. ★Top이 결국 flat/reversal일 위험(최대 실패 메커니즘): index effect는 발표일~효력일 사이에 상당 부분 소진(price runs up to effective date). A_lag=1(effective+1M)으로 진입하면 가장 수익성 큰 프론트런 구간을 이미 놓쳐 D10 drift가 flat이거나, 강제매수 종료 후 mean-reversion으로 D10이 음수일 수 있음. → D10 active term-structure(age별)가 age=0~1에 몰리고 A_lag=1에선 잔여만 남는 구조면 본 알파는 PIT-안전하나 무수익. 이 경우 honest 결론 = "PIT 지키면 alpha 사라짐"(index effect가 KR에선 이미 효율적). top_concentration_test의 age-conditional이 이를 직접 노출.

2. ★PIT 효력일 한계(rationale 페널티 1 실현): 패널이 effective-date만 → announce-date 프론트런(진짜 alpha 구간)을 PIT-안전하게 쓸 수 없음. A_lag=0(announce 가정)은 borderline이라 판정 불가 → 인용 가능한 건 A_lag=1뿐인데 그게 무수익이면(리스크1) 알파 사망. DART 정기변경 공시일 또는 KRX 보도자료 announce_date 수집이 근본 해결이나 현 데이터엔 없음(크로스마켓·대체데이터 금지로 외부 수집도 제약).

3. ★Sparse book(rationale 페널티 2): ~14-20 편입/yr. A_max 짧으면(3M) 동시 eligible 종목 < 20이라 top-20 미충족 → canonical이 가용 전부 보유(집중 과대). A_max 길면(12M) book은 차나 stale decay 종목이 채워 효과 희석 + 비-이벤트월 = 직전 편입 잔류군(holding-extended, 사실상 stale momentum). → "순수 편입 catalyst"가 아니라 "최근 1년 편입종목 바스켓"으로 변질, novelty/mechanism 희석.

4. momentum 재포장 위험: 편입 종목은 편입 전 강세였던 종목 → score가 momentum proxy일 수 있음. corr_active≥0.35면 novelty=5 붕괴(기존 모멘텀의 비싼 재구현). FWL residualize 후에도 D10 t 유지돼야 진짜.

5. KQ150 2010+ 한계 + K200 대형주 편입의 ADV: K200 신규편입은 이미 대형주(시총 200위권 진입)라 ADV 충분 → impact_proxy(수요/ADV)가 작아 footprint 차별화 약할 수 있음(가장 충격 큰 편입 = 중형→대형 경계, 희소). KQ150 편입이 충격 더 크나 2010+·소형주 노이즈·유동성 2e8 필터 탈락 가능.

6. survivorship/편출 미사용: 편출(1→0) 종목 short은 공매도 불가(long-only)라 미사용 — 편출 효과(downward pressure)는 본 알파가 포착 불가(AX-007 buy-side만). 따라서 mechanism의 절반(편출)은 구조적 사각.

7. turnover: 편입군이 매월 바뀌면 회전 ↑. decay τ가 짧으면 top 빠르게 교체 → 15bps×고회전이 net active 잠식. turnover_annual 1100% 게이트(measurement-graduation) 근접 위험, net_sr이 gross 대비 크게 하락 가능.

종합 정직 판정 경로: D10 t>0 유의 ∧ gap>0 ∧ placebo 붕괴 ∧ ortho 충족이면 sparse-sleeve로 가치(OVERLAY/FR/DPL). 그러나 리스크1·2 동시 실현(PIT 지키면 flat) 가능성이 가장 크며, 그 경우 "KR index effect는 효력일 기준 PIT 하에 소멸"을 honest finding으로 보고(AX-000 정직보고) — 실패도 L-code(VALIDATED_HARD_FAIL) 적립 가치.
specs.data_inputs_note: RAWDATA.parquet는 일간(8971일), Size=시총(KRW 천원). 멤버십 panel은 월말. 둘의 frequency 차이는 build_steps 2에서 월말 스냅으로 정렬. C15 carve-out: 멤버십·가격 raw는 Factor DB 아님(load_month_factors 불요), PIT-aligned merge는 호출자 책임.
specs.pit_notes_addendum: main config = A_lag=1 (effective+1M, PIT-안전)만 판정 인용. A_lag=0은 'PIT-borderline(announce −21d 가정)' 라벨로 sensitivity-only. 효력일-only 패널 한계는 honest_risks 2에 명시.

specs.name: C28_Insider_Cluster_Conviction_Buy
specs.construction:
Signal definition (top-concentrated, buy-side only, AX-007 escape). At each rebalance t (month-end sig_date), score for stock i = strength of the open-market insider BUY cluster in the trailing K-month window [t-K+1, t].

RAW EVENT (one elestock report row) = (rcept_dt, repror[reporter name], sp_stock_lmp_irds_cnt[signed change in held specified-securities qty], sp_stock_lmp_irds_rate[signed change in ownership %p], isu_exctv_rgist_at[registered vs unregistered exec]).
- BUY event := sp_stock_lmp_irds_cnt > 0. EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED on the 9790-row cache: 8376 buy (>0), 1244 sell (<0), 170 zero. The sign of irds_cnt IS the buy/sell gate. The collector's change_on/trade_type parsing is DEAD CODE (elestock never returns change_on) — must NOT be used; recompute trade direction from the irds_cnt sign.
- SELL / zero events (irds_cnt <= 0) contribute nothing (long-only, buy-side only).

TWO STACKED RARITY GATES (this is the top-concentration engine):
  Gate 1 (event-occurred): only stocks with >=1 BUY event in the window are candidates. Most stocks = 0 -> these form D1..D9 no-event bulk.
  Gate 2 (cluster): distinct_buyers_{i,t} = count of DISTINCT repror (reporters) who filed a positive-irds BUY for stock i within the window.

score_{i,t} = distinct_buyers_{i,t}  (integer; 0 = not a candidate)
  tie-break 1: conviction_size_{i,t} = sum over window buyers of sp_stock_lmp_irds_rate (larger %p acquired = sharper, Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski opportunistic informativeness).
  tie-break 2: recency = most recent BUY event closest to t ranks higher.
  Optional registered-exec weighting (a lookback_grid branch): weight distinct-buyer contribution 1.0 if isu_exctv_rgist_at=='등기임원' (registered), 0.5 if '비등기임원'/major shareholder — registered execs are sharper. Cache is mostly '비등기임원', so this is a tunable, not baseline.

FINAL SELECTION: rank by score desc -> conviction_size -> recency, take top-N (N=20, max 25) EW long-only. If fewer than N cluster stocks exist that month, hold only the available names (UNDER-FILLED month — the central failure risk).

MECHANISM: a single gate (an insider buy happened at all) is already rare; the second gate (multiple independent insiders buying simultaneously) thins it further so only D10 = genuine multi-insider conviction clusters. This is categorically distinct from the anonymous aggregate flows C21/C22 that already failed: named insiders are the sharpest information source.

specs.pit_notes:
C1 (no full-sample stats): scores use only trailing-window rolling counts; no full-sample normalization. Integer counts need no z-scoring, eliminating a common C1 leak.
C2/C3 (no same-day circular): event included only if its rcept_dt (DART receipt date) <= sig_date t. Receipt date IS the public-disclosure timestamp, so using it at t is PIT-clean.
C4 (filing lag): N/A for prices, but DART insider disclosure is itself lagged (statutory 5-business-day report rule) — we key off rcept_dt (when it became public), not the trade date, so we never see a trade before it was disclosable. This is the correct PIT anchor.
C5 (overlay t-1): selection at t uses only [<=t] events; returns are forward t+1.
C6 (survivorship): universe membership taken from RAWDATA K200/KQ150 flags AT each Date (delisted/dropped names retain their then-current flags), not a current constituent list.
C10 (liquidity t-1): adv computed from t-1 and earlier only.
C13 (no sign-flip): score is a natural positive buy-conviction magnitude; no NEGATE/FLIP — buy-side only by construction.
C14 (IC/usable-date): every insider row's effective Usable_Date = rcept_dt <= sig_date enforced in the pre-pass filter.
C15 (factor DB access): any reused factor (momentum/size/value) pulled via load_month_factors(), not raw parquet. Insider parquet is a non-factor-DB catalyst cache (allowed; it is not the frozen factor DB).
Explicit guard: discard the dead change_on/trade_type column; never infer direction from a future-revised holdings snapshot.
specs.top_concentration_test:
Because the signal is a discrete catalyst (most stocks score 0), a naive cross-sectional decile would put all zeros in D1..D9 and make the test degenerate. Use a TWO-LAYER test:

LAYER A — event-vs-no-event (the first rarity gate): each month split the universe into {cluster stocks (score>=1)} vs {no-event bulk}. Form the EW long-only no-event portfolio as the de-facto D1..D5 baseline; the cluster set is the concentrated top. Compute the cluster-minus-bulk net active series and its NW lag-3 t-stat via canonical_screen_bt (run twice: once with scores as-is, once with an all-equal score to get the bulk baseline).

LAYER B — within-cluster deciles by conviction (the second gate): RANK only the event-positive stocks (pooled across months) into deciles by score=distinct_buyers (with conviction_size tie-break). Because clusters are sparse, use conviction-weighted deciles (equal event mass per decile, not equal name count). Report for each D1..D10: mean monthly net active return, hit rate, avg distinct_buyers, avg conviction_size, n_obs.
- D10 t-stat: NW lag-3 t of the D10-only top-N EW long-only book vs BM (canonical_screen_bt on D10 members). HARD interpretive bar: portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 >= 2.95 for a graduation claim (else screening-tier only).
- D10-D9 gap: mean active return D10 minus D9, with a block-bootstrap (block=12m) CI on the gap; require the gap to be positive and its bootstrap 5th percentile > 0 to claim the extreme top is a real return cliff (not noise from thin n). Also report monotonicity (Spearman of decile index vs mean active) — a true conviction signal should be roughly monotone, not a single-decile spike that is more likely overfit to a handful of months.
- Fill diagnostic: report, per month, how many cluster stocks existed and how often the top-20 book was under-filled — a top that is 'strong' only because it averaged 4 names in lucky months is a false positive.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
Targets (active/−BM basis per measurement-graduation §6, not gross): want |corr| low so this adds book-marginal IR (ΔIR>=0.05).
- vs momentum (M32/M05 composite): target |corr| < 0.30. Risk: insider clusters may follow price runs (momentum contamination) — MEASURE and report; if |corr| > 0.5 the signal is a momentum proxy.
- vs size (Size): target |corr| < 0.40. Real risk: insider-cluster events skew to small/mid names (cache 280 tickers, many non-K200) — a small-cap tilt would explain returns without a true insider edge. Neutralize check: re-run the cluster book within size terciles.
- vs value/BM and quality: target |corr| < 0.30 (no strong prior).
- vs C21/C22 anonymous institutional flow: target |corr| < 0.25 — this is the KEY discriminator. C28 must be shown CATEGORICALLY distinct from the failed aggregate-flow factors; if corr is high, C28 inherits their failure.
- vs DART buyback/repror overlap with self-buyback (C-series): ensure the insider buy is a person, not the issuer treasury program double-counted.
Method: monthly active-return correlation of the C28 top-N book vs each comparator's top-N book over the common window (load_month_factors for comparators).

specs.honest_risks:
1. DATA WINDOW (the decisive drag, feasibility=2): cache is only 2024-03..2026-03 (~24 months, 280 tickers). For a rare-event signal this is too few months for a stable NW lag-3 t-stat; the t could be large by luck. Pre-2015 DART elestock coverage is genuinely sparse and pre-2009 near-empty, so reaching a 2005+ campaign window is a REAL, honestly-flagged risk — backfill may simply not yield enough pre-2020 events, capping statistical power regardless of code quality.
2. UNDER-FILLED BOOK -> TOP GOES FLAT: within K200|KQ150 + liquidity filter, multi-buyer clusters per month will often be << 20 (the 639 >=2-buyer ticker-months were across ALL of KR incl. non-index small caps over 24m). In thin months the 'top' book is 3-8 names or partially cash-like, so the concentrated top can dilute toward flat — exactly the failure the schema warns about.
3. SMALL-CAP / LIQUIDITY TILT: insider-cluster names skew small/mid; returns may be a size premium, not insider edge. If the size-tercile-neutralized cluster book loses its alpha, the signal is a size proxy (orthogonality target < 0.40).
4. POST-DISCLOSURE DRIFT EXHAUSTION: by the time DART discloses (statutory lag) and we trade at t+1, the informed move may be priced — the realized active return at monthly horizon could be ~0 even if the raw event is informative. Top is informative but NOT tradable.
5. SIGN/DIRECTION BUG: relying on the dead change_on column would mislabel buys/sells; must use irds_cnt sign. A subtler risk: irds_cnt is a holdings DELTA snapshot that can be revised — only the as-of-rcept_dt value is PIT-valid.
6. CLUSTER != CONVICTION: multiple filings can be one event split across family/affiliated reporters (related parties), inflating distinct_buyers without independent conviction. Dedup by reporter identity/affiliation may be needed; if not, D10 is noise.
7. OVERFIT TO A FEW MONTHS: with thin n, a single-decile spike (non-monotone) is likely month-specific luck — the monotonicity + bootstrap gap test is there precisely to catch a top that is flat-or-short outside a lucky window.

specs.name: M37_Buyback_Confirmed_Breakout
specs.construction:
CO-OCCURRENCE SIGNAL: a price breakout that is CONFIRMED by an active corporate buyback within the trailing window. Two independent rare events multiplied → near-degenerate top.

Per sig_date d (month-end trading day), per Ticker i, using ONLY data with Date < d (C2 strict):

1) BREAKOUT STRENGTH (Donchian base-breakout, from OHLC, continuous not binary — avoid degeneracy):
   N=120 trading-day Donchian channel measured at d-1.
   chan_high_{d-1} = max(High over [d-1-N+1 .. d-1])  (EXCLUDING d-1's own High to avoid same-day; use High up to d-2 in channel, test at d-1 — see pit_notes)
   BRK_dist = (Close_{d-1} - chan_high_excl_{d-1}) / chan_high_excl_{d-1}      # >0 = new-high breakout, magnitude of penetration
   BASE_tightness = 1 / (1 + sd(dailyRet over [d-1-63 .. d-1]) )                # tight base before break = cleaner setup (flat-then-spike)
   VOL_confirm = Vol_{d-1} / ADV20_{d-1}                                        # breakout on volume expansion (>1)
   BRK_score_raw = max(BRK_dist, 0) * BASE_tightness * log1p(VOL_confirm)       # 0 if not a new high (one-sided, long-only natural)

2) BUYBACK CONFIRMATION (from stock_buyback.parquet SBB, PIT via Factor_Date; insider table 2024+ only → NOT usable full-sample, see honest_risks):
   SBB_active = 1 if the most recent SBB record with Factor_Date < d has Value > 0 within the trailing 2 quarters (≈ 2 Factor_Date observations), else 0.
   SBB_intensity = (trailing-2Q SBB Value, latest available) / Size_{d-1}        # buyback amount as % of market cap (continuous conviction)
   CONF = SBB_active * (0.5 + 0.5 * z_xs(log1p(SBB_intensity)))                  # gate × graded intensity; if SBB_active==0 → CONF=0

3) FINAL SCORE (multiplicative co-occurrence — this is the degeneracy lever the concept wants):
   score_i = z_xs(BRK_score_raw) * CONF_i                                       # both must be present and strong
   PRIMARY variant. score = NA (drop) when BRK_score_raw==0 OR SBB_active==0 (honest sparsity, NOT future leak).

   ABLATIONS (orthogonality + decomposition, same engine):
   A) BRK_only:  score = z_xs(BRK_score_raw)                                     # breakout alone (no buyback gate)
   B) CONF_only: score = z_xs(SBB_intensity) on SBB_active==1                    # buyback alone (= M_BuybackDrift analog)
   C) ADD form:  score = z_xs(BRK_score_raw) + z_xs(CONF) (soft, less degenerate, wider breadth)
   D) OVERLAY:   per concept author's own recommendation — feed PRIMARY as a TILT on M33/M35 momentum base, not standalone top-20 (see build_steps 9).

Higher score = preferred. Long-only top-N EW via canonical_screen_bt (N=20 primary; 15/25 robustness). 15bps one-way, liq 2e8 floor.

NO hand-synth (no prod(1+r)/cumprod for portfolio; the only prod(1+Ret) use is forward-LABEL construction, identical to sibling build_m36.R/build_othercorp_alpha.R precedent, which is allowed). Cross-sectional z = winsor 1/99% then (x-mean)/sd per Date (no pooling = C1). rank-IC = monthly Spearman(score, fwd Ret_1m), ICIR, Harvey-t for diagnostics only — REMEMBER rank-IC≠port_t (Cycle-2, AX-007). Pre-registered primary + robustness diagnostic grid (selection_type='chain' — hypothesis-driven, NOT argmax sweep; DSR advisory only):

- Base window (tightness sd): {42, 63} td. PRIMARY=63.
- Buyback trailing window: {1Q, 2Q} of SBB Factor_Date observations. PRIMARY=2Q (~6mo, matches breakout horizon; 1Q too sparse).

- top_n: {15, 20, 25}. PRIMARY=20.
- Variant: {PRIMARY(mult), ADD, BRK_only, CONF_only}. PRIMARY=mult.

specs.top_concentration_test:
THE central test (this concept lives or dies on D10). Procedure on PRIMARY scores merged with forward Ret_1m:
1) DECILE PROFILE: per sig_date, rank non-NA scores into deciles D1..D10 (D10=highest). For each decile compute EW forward active return (− BM_Ret). Average across months → decile_return_profile[D1..D10] + monthly t-stat per decile (NW lag-3). Plot/table the 10 means. HEALTHY = monotone rise AND D10 clearly above D9. FAILURE MODE = monotone in D1..D8 but D9≈D10 flat (the OtherCorp WT-005 disease: monotonicity 0.733 but top-flat → port_t −0.52).
2) D10 t-STAT: regress D10 monthly active (net 15bps) on constant, NW lag-3 t. This is the de-facto top-20-proxy edge. Need |t|≥2 just to be interesting; ≥2.95 for graduation relevance.
3) D10−D9 GAP: mean(D10_active) − mean(D9_active), with paired-month t-stat (NW lag-3 on the monthly difference series). If gap t<1.5 → 'top is not special', the co-occurrence buys nothing beyond decile 9 → route to OVERLAY/ADD, kill standalone.
4) BREADTH-CONDITIONAL D10: because score=NA unless BOTH breakout AND SBB_active, eligible-name count/month will be LOW. Report median/min eligible names/month and #months<20. If breadth median <20, top-20 is forced to dip into non-co-occurrence names (score=0/NA filled) → D10 is diluted → measure 'pure-co-occurrence sub-portfolio' return separately (only months with ≥20 eligible).
5) DEGENERACY CHECK: fraction of months where D10 = D9 = ... (ties from sparse population). If many months have <100 scored names, deciles collapse — report effective decile resolution.
6) FLAT-THEN-SPIKE diagnostic: split D10 months into 'had a true breakout (BRK_dist>0)' vs 'filled' — confirm the realized edge comes from genuine co-occurrence, not from EW-fallback into momentum names.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
Measure monthly-median Spearman corr of PRIMARY score vs each, via load_month_factors (C15-clean):
- M_BuybackDrift / SBB-based factors (the closest sibling): TARGET |corr| < 0.5 — the breakout gate MUST add a distinct axis; if |corr|≥0.6 the breakout is decorative and concept = M_BuybackDrift rebrand (kill).
- Generic momentum (12-1, 6-1 / M33/M35 base): TARGET |corr| < 0.6 — breakout is momentum-adjacent by construction; the buyback gate is what should de-correlate it. If |corr| with M33/M35 ≥0.7, OVERLAY use is the only honest route.
- 52-week-high (George-Hwang) if present: expect HIGH |corr| (0.5–0.8) with BRK_only ablation — informative, not disqualifying.
- INV/Flow factors (INV01-13): expect LOW |corr| (<0.3) — buyback is corporate-action, not investor-flow cohort.
- Size/value: TARGET |corr| < 0.3 (breakout has small-cap tilt risk → check Size corr explicitly; if strongly small-tilted, neutralize-Size ablation).
Report the ABLATION decomposition: corr(PRIMARY, BRK_only) and corr(PRIMARY, CONF_only) — shows whether mult-score is dominated by one leg.
