6. Universe filter at sig_date: (K200|KQ150)==1 as-of d-1; drop AdminStock/TradingHalt/UnfaithfulDisc; require Size_lag>0.
7. Build cross-sectional scores per variant (PRIMARY mult / ADD / BRK_only / CONF_only): winsor 1/99% + z by Date; apply co-occurrence NA-drop rule. Emit alpha_scores.parquet for PRIMARY.

8. Build returns_dt (forward 1M realized over (d, d+1month-end], label-grade prod(1+Ret)), liq_dt (ADV20 t-1), bench_dt (monthly KOSPI200 TR from benchmark.parquet). Restrict to universe keys. (exact sibling build_m36 pattern)
9. Run canonical_screen_bt for each grid cell (N×buyback-win×top_n + 4 variants). Log PORT_t, IR, net_sr, turnover, alpha_ann per cell.
10. BREADTH report: median/min eligible-names/month per cell; flag months<20 (degeneracy). This gates whether standalone top-20 is even coherent.
11. TOP-CONCENTRATION test (the make-or-break): decile profile + D10 NW-t + D10-D9 gap t + pure-co-occurrence sub-portfolio + flat-then-spike split (top_concentration_test procedure).
12. ORTHOGONALITY: monthly-median Spearman vs M_BuybackDrift/momentum/52wH/INV/Size via load_month_factors; ablation corr(PRIMARY,BRK_only/CONF_only).

13. OVERLAY test (author's recommended use): apply PRIMARY as a multiplicative tilt on M33/M35 base scores; canonical_screen_bt the overlaid portfolio; compare PORT_t vs M33/M35 standalone (ΔPORT_t, Δturnover). This is the realistic graduation route, not standalone.

14. Emit alpha_package_draft.json with metric_type='canonical_screen', honest verdict (likely SCREEN_ROUTE / OVERLAY_CANDIDATE per concept author + OtherCorp precedent), challenge_flags, selection_type='chain'. Codex Critic Round before final.
specs.honest_risks:
1. TOP-FLAT (PRIMARY RISK, precedent-confirmed): The directly-adjacent OtherCorp alpha (WT-D20260621_005, also a 'rare corporate-conviction event') was cross-sectionally monotone (0.733) but TOP DECILES FLAT → port_t −0.52, ALL 27 grid cells negative. Co-occurrence factors notoriously rank-IC-positive but port_t-flat (rank-IC≠realized active return, AX-007 long-only translation). M37 is structurally the SAME family → expect the same disease. This is the most likely outcome.
2. BREADTH COLLAPSE → DEGENERATE TOP (the concept author's OWN feasibility=2 flag): score requires BOTH a 120d breakout AND active buyback. In KR, monthly co-occurrence count likely <20 names → top-20 is FORCED to fill with score=0/NA momentum fallback, so D10 is NOT actually 'pure co-occurrence' — the measured edge becomes a diluted momentum proxy. Mitigation: pure-co-occurrence sub-portfolio test + ADD variant + OVERLAY route.
3. DATA REALITY ≠ CONCEPT: concept asks for 'DART buyback/insider disclosure within trailing window, rcept_dt PIT' (event stream). REALITY: (a) insider_trades.parquet is 2024+ ONLY (9,790 rows) → insider confirmation INFEASIBLE pre-2024, DROPPED. (b) stock_buyback.parquet SBB is QUARTERLY level data (Factor_Date PIT), NOT an event-announcement table → 'confirmation within trailing window' becomes a coarse 2Q gate, not a sharp event. The sharp flat-then-spike-only-D10-populated design the concept envisions is NOT buildable with cached data; would need a fresh DART list.json buyback-announcement (자기주식취득결정) collector (feasibility cost, out of alpha-research scope).
4. SMALL-CAP / LIQUIDITY TILT: breakouts concentrate in low-priced KOSDAQ names → high turnover + illiquidity. Liq 2e8 floor + 15bps will eat thin breakout edges; turnover likely >10x/yr (cost-model under-counts >10x per B0 fee-bug — flag if so).
5. BUYBACK ≠ BULLISH in KR: KR buybacks often signal defensive value (mature low-growth) not momentum — the buyback gate may ANTI-select against breakout momentum, making the mult-score internally conflicting (CONF picks value, BRK picks momentum → empty/contradictory intersection). The ablation corr(BRK_only, CONF_only) will reveal if the two legs are negatively related (intersection systematically empty).
6. REDUNDANCY: if |corr| with M_BuybackDrift ≥0.6, the breakout gate adds nothing measurable and M37 is a rebrand → kill. HONEST EXPECTATION: standalone graduation (PORT_t≥2.95 + oos≥0.7 + calmar≥0.64) is unlikely; realistic best case is OVERLAY_CANDIDATE on M33/M35 or DPL_FEATURE — exactly as the concept author recommended (priority_tier B, 'OVERLAY not standalone').

specs.name: M_TripleRevisionUnanimity
specs.construction:
CORE IDEA — a non-compensatory COUNT gate over three consensus FY1-revision lines, gated by analyst breadth, then ranked within the gated set. NOT a z-average (that is C19's compensatory shape, which mid-peaks). The gate isolates a small genuine-fundamental-acceleration set where EPS AND OP AND Revenue all revised up.

THREE REVISION LINES (all from the consensus factor family, already in factor DB):
  L1 = C02_EPS_Chg_1m  (1m EPS FY1 revision %)
  L2 = C17_OP_Revision  ((op_now - op_lag_63d)/|op_lag|, FY1 operating profit)
  L3 = C14_Revenue_Surprise ((rev_now - rev_lag_63d)/|rev_lag|, FY1 revenue)
BREADTH GATE input: C04_ESBR (earnings sentiment breadth ratio, in [0,1]-ish, fraction of brokers revising up).

PER-MONTH SIGNAL (at each month-end sig_date d, within universe U_d = K200∪KQ150 ∩ ADV20(t-1)>=2e8):
  Step A (direction of each line):  up_k(i) = 1{ Z_Score_Aligned(L_k, i, d) > 0 } for k in {L1,L2,L3}.
     Rationale: each L_k is a revision-magnitude factor with empirically positive IC, so IC-aligned Z>0 == 'this firm revised up vs the cross-section this month'. (Primary arm; see lookback_grid for a raw->0 absolute-sign variant.)
  Step B (unanimity count):  cnt(i) = up_L1(i) + up_L2(i) + up_L3(i)  in {0,1,2,3}. Require all three lines non-missing (n_valid==3) else drop i (do NOT impute a missing line as up — non-compensatory).
  Step C (breadth gate):  pass(i) = 1{ cnt(i) == 3  AND  esbr_z(i) > 0.6 }, where esbr_z is the cross-sectional rank-percentile of C04_ESBR within U_d (percentile in [0,1], so >0.6 == top-40% breadth). Using a within-universe percentile (not the raw 0.6 ESBR level) makes the 0.6 threshold scale-stable across the consensus-vendor's ESBR units and across regimes — this is the gate that creates the rarity.
  Step D (score = magnitude WITHIN the gated set):  for gated names (pass==1), score(i) = z(C02)+z(C17)+z(C14) using within-GATED-SET cross-sectional z (re-standardized over the survivors only, so we rank acceleration intensity among genuine unanimous upgraders, not vs the whole universe). For non-gated names, score(i) = NA (excluded from the long book).
  Step E (portfolio):  top-N EW long-only over score among pass==1 names. If |gated set| < N in a month, hold only the available gated names EW (do not back-fill from non-gated — the rarity is the alpha; a forced 25 dilutes it). Track months_gate_count = |pass==1| as a first-class diagnostic.

This is build-ready inside the existing fe_earnrev.R scaffold: same load_month_factors(d) -> Z_Score_Aligned path, same K200∪KQ150 + 2e8 universe, same month-end grid from 2002-08, only the combine block changes (count-gate replacing z-sum).
build_steps: 1. Copy 02_Infrastructure/alpha_search/fe_earnrev.R to fe_trunan.R; keep the universe block (K200∪KQ150 + frollmean ADV20 >= 2e8, month_ends from .fdb_min=2002-08-01) and the load_month_factors(d) per-month loop verbatim.

2. Replace CORE_4F with REV_LINES <- c('C02_EPS_Chg_1m','C17_OP_Revision','C14_Revenue_Surprise') and GATE <- 'C04_ESBR'. Confirm all four resolve in load_month_factors output via a one-month smoke print (uniqueN(Ticker) per Factor_Name) — C14/C17 depend on revenue_fy1/op_profit_fy1 being present in the consensus cache; if either line is empty pre-~2008, log coverage-by-year and treat short history honestly (do NOT silently drop to 2 lines).
3. In the per-month combine block, dcast the 4 factors wide (Ticker x Factor_Name of Z_Score_Aligned), restricted to uni_tk. Drop rows missing any of the 3 REV_LINES (require n_valid==3).
4. Compute up_k = 1{Z>0} for the 3 lines; cnt = rowSums(up). Compute esbr_pct = frank(C04_ESBR)/.N (within-universe percentile). pass = (cnt==3) & (esbr_pct > 0.6).
5. Among pass==TRUE rows: re-standardize z(C02)+z(C17)+z(C14) over survivors only; Score = that sum. Emit FACTORS(Date,Ticker,Score) for pass names only. Record gate_count[d]=sum(pass).

6. Build returns_dt (Date,Ticker,Ret_1m = forward 1M realized, PIT-aligned: signal at month-end d -> return over [d, next month-end]) and bench_dt (Date,BM_Ret KOSPI200 TR) and liq_dt(Date,Ticker,adv = ADV20 at t-1) from RAWDATA, exactly as canonical_screen_bt expects.

7. Call canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt=FACTORS, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8). Read portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, information_ratio, net_sr, turnover_annual, period_returns.

8. Run the top_concentration_test (see field): rebuild scores over the FULL universe ranked by the same score formula (no gate), cut into deciles D1..D10 by score, run canonical_screen_bt per decile (top_n large enough to hold the decile, or EW the whole decile), and separately backtest the gated book. Compare D10 vs D9 vs gated-only.

9. Run orthogonality_targets check (see field): canonical_screen_bt of this signal's period_returns active series vs C19_Composite_Earnings, C02 standalone, and STR_1715 core sleeve active series; report active-basis pairwise corr.

10. Report with metric_type label = 'canonical_screen' (NOT 'backtested'); do not claim graduation — this is a screening-tier real measurement. If gate_count median < ~8 names/month, flag breadth-of-book risk explicitly (concentration may be unbacktestable as a 20-name book).
specs.construction_note: primary arm uses Z_Score_Aligned>0 as the per-line up/down direction (stays inside load_month_factors PIT path); a raw-revision absolute-sign variant is a documented sweep arm.
specs.estimator: No fitted estimator — this is a rule-based COUNT-gate signal, deliberately parameter-light to avoid overfitting a rarity gate. The only free knobs are (a) the ESBR percentile threshold (0.6 default) and (b) line-direction definition (Z>0 vs raw>0). Cross-sectional standardization within the gated set is the only 'estimation' and is recomputed each month (no full-sample stats -> C1 clean). For the top-concentration test, decile cutpoints are per-month cross-sectional quantiles of the ungated score (also rolling/PIT-clean). If a sweep over the ESBR threshold is run, it MUST be declared selection_type='sweep' and carry DSR (>=2 threshold candidates is enumerated argmax) per measurement-graduation §3; the single-threshold default (0.6) backtested once is selection_type='chain' (DSR-exempt, PORT_t 2.95 governs).
specs.lookback_grid: Line-revision windows are FIXED by the factor-DB definitions, not free: C02 = 1m EPS revision (vendor-native), C17/C14 = 63-calendar-day lag deltas (as compute_consensus.R hardcodes). Sweep arms (run as a declared sweep with DSR, or pick one a-priori as chain): (1) ESBR percentile gate ∈ {top-30% (>0.7), top-40% (>0.6, default), top-50% (>0.5)} — looser gate = bigger book/softer rarity; (2) unanimity count threshold cnt>=3 (default, true unanimity) vs cnt>=2 (majority, a deliberate compensatory-leak control to prove the 3rd line matters); (3) line-direction = Z_Score_Aligned>0 (default) vs raw FY1-revision>0 (absolute up, needs raw loader); (4) holding/rebalance = monthly (default) with a 3-month signal-persistence overlay as a turnover-control arm. Signal grid = month-ends, history from 2002-08-01 (factor DB consensus start); report coverage-by-year because C14/C17 (revenue/OP FY1) may have thinner early coverage than C02.
specs.data_inputs: All from existing factor DB consensus family via load_month_factors(sig_date) -> Z_Score_Aligned (no new collection, feasibility=5): C02_EPS_Chg_1m (compute_consensus.R from CONSENSUS$eps_chg_1m), C17_OP_Revision (from CONSENSUS$op_profit_fy1, 63d-lag delta), C14_Revenue_Surprise (from CONSENSUS$revenue_fy1, 63d-lag delta), C04_ESBR (from CONSENSUS$esbr). Universe: RAWDATA columns Date,Ticker,Close,Vol,K200,KQ150 (membership + ADV20 = frollmean(Close*Vol,20) for the 2e8 liquidity filter). Benchmark: RAWDATA$BM_Ret (KOSPI200 total return). Returns: forward 1M realized from RAWDATA Ret/Close. Source files: 02_Infrastructure/factor_db/compute_consensus.R (C02/C04/C14/C17 builders), factor_db_connector.R::load_month_factors, data/consensus_parser.R (revenue_fy1/op_profit_fy1/eps_chg_1m/esbr ingestion). NO DART, NO investor-flow, NO cross-market.
specs.pit_notes: C1 (no full-sample stats): per-line direction and the within-gated-set z are computed on the sig_date cross-section only; decile cutpoints are per-month quantiles. No expanding/full-sample moments. C2 (no same-day circular): score(d) uses only data with Date<=d; forward return is over [d, d+1m], never feeding back. C4 (statement lag): consensus revisions carry the vendor's announcement timing; C17/C14 use a 63-day lag delta and the factor DB Usable_Date already enforces IC availability (load_month_factors filters Usable_Date<=sig_date for the IC direction). C5 (overlay t-1): the optional 3m-persistence arm uses past signals only. C10 (liquidity t-1): ADV20 via frollmean align='right' through t-1, liq_min=2e8. C13 (no NEGATE/FLIP): directions come from Z_Score_Aligned whose sign is set by expanding-window IC inside load_month_factors — we never hand-flip; for the raw-sign variant we use the economically-signed raw revision (up=positive) with no ad hoc negation. C14 (IC Usable_Date<=sig_date): inherited from load_month_factors' align_factor_direction. C15 (no direct parquet load): all factors via load_month_factors, never raw factor parquet. C6 (survivorship): universe is point-in-time K200/KQ150 membership from RAWDATA per month-end. The ONLY PIT subtlety: the gated-set re-standardization (Step D) is cross-sectional at d, so it is C1-clean; do not pool gated sets across months for the z.
specs.top_concentration_test: PURPOSE: prove the extreme top is REAL excess return and a genuine spike, not a ramp that mid-peaks (the C19 failure mode) nor a top that goes flat/short. PROCEDURE: (1) DECILE PROFILE — build the SAME magnitude score = z(C02)+z(C17)+z(C14) over the FULL universe (NO gate), each month rank into deciles D1..D10 by score; run canonical_screen_bt on each decile as an EW long-only book (hold the whole decile, or top_n sized to the decile) -> get net mean active return and portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 PER decile. Plot D1..D10 mean-active profile: a TRUE top-concentration signal is monotone-increasing AND convex at the top (D10 >> D9), NOT hump-shaped (which would mean C19-style mid-peak) and NOT D10<D9 (top decay = short risk). (2) D10 t-stat — report portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 for the D10 EW book in isolation; require it materially positive (target the screening bar, and read against the 2.95 graduation reference) on net-of-15bps active. (3) D10-D9 GAP — gap = mean_active_net(D10) - mean_active_net(D9), with a paired-bootstrap (block=12m) CI on the monthly active-return difference series; a real spike has gap>0 with CI excluding 0; gap<=0 falsifies 'extreme top is special' and means this is a smooth factor not a concentration gate. (4) GATED-BOOK vs D10 — separately backtest the ACTUAL gated book (cnt==3 & esbr_pct>0.6): if the gated book's net alpha t and net_sr EXCEED the ungated D10 book, the unanimity+breadth GATE adds value beyond raw magnitude ranking (the whole thesis); if gated≈D10, the gate is redundant decoration and the signal is just 'high revision magnitude'. (5) RARITY/BACKTESTABILITY — report gate_count median & distribution; if median gated names < ~12/month the 20-name book is mechanically forced to dilute with lower-conviction names -> note that the pure-concentration alpha may be smaller than the deployable book can express, and consider reporting an N=gate_count variable-size book alongside the fixed-20.
specs.orthogonality_targets: Measure ACTIVE-basis (signal minus BM) correlation, NOT gross — per measurement-graduation §6, long-only KR sleeves share β≈0.99 so gross corr is inflated (~0.78) while active corr is the real number (~0.45). Targets: vs C19_Composite_Earnings (the compensatory z-average baseline this concept claims to beat) target |active corr| < 0.6 — must show the non-compensatory gate produces a DIFFERENT book than the smooth composite (if >0.8 the gate is cosmetic). vs C02_EPS_Chg_1m standalone (single-line) target |active corr| < 0.7 — must show OP+Revenue confirmation moves the book. vs STR_1715 core earnings-revision sleeve (incumbent book component) target |active corr| < 0.5 for book-marginal value (ΔIR relevance). vs the 9 path/flow failure signals: expected near-orthogonal (different data family) — confirm |active corr| < 0.4, which is the concept's stated clean-orthogonality claim. METHOD: build each comparator's monthly active-net series via canonical_screen_bt (same universe/cost), then pairwise Pearson on the active series; report the n_months overlap (early years thin for C14/C17).
specs.honest_risks: 1. RAMP-NOT-SPIKE (the concept's own top_concentration=4 caveat): inputs are thresholded continuous revision magnitudes, not binary corporate events, so the D10 profile may ramp smoothly rather than spike — D10-D9 gap could be ~0, making this 'just a revision-magnitude factor' with no special top. This is the single most likely failure and the test above is designed to expose it. 2. TOP GOES FLAT/SHORT — unanimous up-revisions can be a CROWDING/late-cycle signal: by the time EPS+OP+Revenue all visibly revise up and breadth is high, the news may be priced (post-earnings-drift exhausted), so the gated top could realize flat or negative net active, especially after costs. KR analyst revisions are sticky/herding, raising this risk. 3. RARITY -> UNBACKTESTABLE BOOK — true unanimity (cnt==3) + top-40% breadth may leave <10 names/month, especially in down markets when revisions are broadly negative; a 20-name book then either dilutes (kills the alpha) or runs <10 names (concentration/idiosyncratic-blowup risk, and turnover spikes as the thin set churns). 4. C14/C17 COVERAGE — revenue_fy1/op_profit_fy1 consensus may be sparse in early years (pre-~2008) or for KQ150 smalls; thin coverage biases the gate toward large K200 names and shortens usable history — must report coverage-by-year, not paper over it. 5. ESBR UNIT INSTABILITY — the 0.6 gate relies on ESBR being comparable across time; using a within-universe percentile mitigates this but if ESBR itself is noisy/stale the gate admits noise. 6. PROCYCLICAL TURNOVER — gate membership flips as revisions turn; turnover_annual could blow past the 1100% screen limit, and at 15bps delta-cost that erodes the thin-book alpha. 7. SELECTION on the ESBR threshold — if multiple thresholds are tried, this becomes a sweep and needs DSR; running only the a-priori 0.6 once (chain) avoids that but forgoes knowing the gate's sensitivity. Net honest stance: mechanism is causally clean and data is free, but the realistic modal outcome is screening-tier (signal exists, structure thin) rather than graduation — report PORT_t honestly and route via screen_route if MDD/turnover structure fails while signal is real.

specs.name: C30_Major_Holder_Stake_Build
specs.construction:
DISCRETE-CATALYST event-intensity score from DART major-holder filing (daeryang-boyu, the 5-percent rule = majorstock.json endpoint), kept DISTINCT from C28 officer-cluster (which uses elestock endpoint) and from INV11 anonymous continuous concentration. The score is structurally near-zero for the vast majority of names (no qualifying filing) and large only for stocks with a recent, clean, magnitude-meaningful 5%+ holder stake-INCREASE -- so the cross-section is sparse and top-heavy BY DESIGN. That sparsity is exactly the property top_concentration_test must validate (D1..D9 ~flat baseline, D10 = the real events).

DOUBLE-GATE event definition. A filing-event e (one DART majorstock report row) qualifies only if BOTH:
 (1) THRESHOLD gate: post-event holding ratio stkrt_post >= 5.0 (%) AND report_tp is sin-gyu (new >=5% crossing) OR byeon-dong (change) that keeps stkrt_post >= 5.0. Equity-up only; pure drop-below-5% / de-registration excluded.
 (2) MAGNITUDE gate: delta_stkrt = stkrt_post - stkrt_prev >= mag_min (grid, base 1.0pp). For a new crossing prev:=0 so delta_stkrt:=stkrt_post. This is the 'large informed accumulation' leg -- magnitude, not just threshold.

SIGNAL-PURITY filter (the rationale penalty; applied BEFORE scoring, removes Value-up / intra-group activist noise that contaminates the gate). Drop event e if ANY of: (a) report_resn (boyu-mokjeok) = 'no management-control intent / simple-or-general investment' AND filer is a special-related-party / affiliate (controlling-family reshuffle, no new informed capital); (b) acquire/dispose reason (change_on) in {inheritance, gift, merger, stock-dividend, bonus-issue, in-kind, collateral, stock-split} -- non-purchase mechanical changes whose 'magnitude' is illusory; (c) boyu-mokjeok = 'management-control intent' arising purely from a controlling-shareholder defensive lock-up with NO on-market purchase. KEEP: on-market or block-deal purchase (chwideuk) by a committed single holder, single/general-investment filings backed by an actual on-market purchase, and NEW outside 5%+ blockholders.

STOCK-MONTH SCORE at sig_date t (= month-end trading day; PIT in pit_notes). For each ticker, using ONLY qualifying events with Usable_Date <= t inside trailing window W (grid, base 3 calendar months):
 raw_intensity(i,t) = sum over qualifying events e of [ delta_stkrt(e) * recency_decay(t - Usable_Date(e)) ], recency_decay = exp(-days/halflife), halflife in grid (base 30d). One committed accumulator over W is rewarded; if multiple events from the SAME filer in W, sum their delta (continued 13D-style buying). raw_intensity = 0 if no qualifying event (the flat baseline).
 Final Score(i,t) = cross-sectional rank of raw_intensity within K200_KQ150 universe at t, normalized to (0,1] (rank-invariant, heavy-tail robust, C13-compliant -- no sign flip, higher raw = higher score = buy). Zero-event names share the bottom of the rank block (tie); the event names occupy the top -- so the long basket (top-N) is mechanically the recent-large-accumulation cohort whenever event count >= N.

EXECUTION via canonical_screen_bt: scores_dt = (Date=t, Ticker, score=Score), top_n grid {20,25}, long-only EW, 15bps one-way, liq filter adv>=2e8. Because the signal is sparse, ALSO run the strict event-only variant (drop zero-event names entirely before ranking, so top-N is forced to be pure-event even when n_events<N) to separate 'event alpha' from 'filler dilution'.
specs.estimator: No model fit / no full-sample estimation -- the score is a deterministic event-intensity transform plus a per-date cross-sectional rank (C1-safe: each date's rank uses only that date's cross-section, no pooled/global moments). recency_decay halflife and magnitude/threshold cutoffs are FIXED a-priori constants (not tuned on returns) so there is no estimator that can leak future info. Portfolio = canonical top-N EW long-only via canonical_screen_bt() -> build_benchmark_compare() (NW lag-3 portfolio-alpha t, IR, alpha). Diagnostic decile/IC layer uses Spearman rank-IC of Score vs t+1 monthly return (advisory only; portfolio-alpha t is authoritative per measurement-graduation rule). Selection_type = 'chain' (single hypothesis, sequential mechanism-driven refinement) NOT a sweep -> DSR gate not applied; lookback_grid points are reported as independent robustness, the headline is the pre-committed base config (W=3m, halflife=30d, mag_min=1.0pp, top_n=25), chosen before seeing returns.
specs.lookback_grid: Pre-committed BASE (headline): trailing window W=3 calendar months, recency halflife=30d, mag_min(delta_stkrt)=1.0pp, threshold=5.0%, top_n=25, dilution-mode=strict(event-only). ROBUSTNESS grid (reported as chain robustness, IS-only selection, NOT argmax-picked): W in {1m, 3m, 6m, 12m}; halflife in {15d, 30d, 60d, none(uniform)}; mag_min in {0.5pp, 1.0pp, 2.0pp, 3.0pp}; threshold fixed 5.0% (regulatory, not a free param); top_n in {20, 25}; dilution-mode in {strict event-only, blended rank-of-all}. Hold-back: holdout window reserved for the final config only (one read), per measurement-graduation holdout protocol.
specs.top_concentration_test:
CORE deliverable -- proves the top is REAL excess return, not flat/short. Because the signal is sparse, a naive global-decile split puts all zero-event names in low deciles and is uninformative; run TWO complementary tests:

TEST A (event-conditional decile profile). Restrict to stock-months WITH a qualifying event (raw_intensity>0). Within that event subsample, each month sort into deciles D1..D10 by raw_intensity (D10 = largest, most-recent accumulations). For each decile compute the EW long-only top-basket net active return (canonical_screen_bt machinery, 15bps), build the D1..D10 monthly active-return panel. Report: (i) monotonicity of mean active return across D1..D10; (ii) D10 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3) -- the headline; (iii) D10 - D9 gap with a paired-difference NW t-stat (long D10 / short-as-benchmark D9, measured as active-return difference series, t = mean(diff)/NW-se(diff)). PASS criterion for 'genuine top concentration' = D10 portfolio-alpha t >= 2.95 AND D10-D9 gap t > 1.5 AND D10 mean active > D9 mean active > broad-event mean (top strictly dominates, not a flat plateau).

TEST B (sparse-universe production decile). On the FULL K200_KQ150 cross-section (zero-event names included), the 'top decile' in months with >=20 events is pure-event; in thin months it is padded. Build the actual top_n=25 EW long-only portfolio via canonical_screen_bt (strict event-only AND blended modes) and report its portfolio-alpha t. Then the falsification: compute the SAME portfolio's return in the subset of months where it had to be PADDED with zero-event filler vs months it was pure-event -- if alpha lives only in pure-event months, the production signal is event-real; if padded months carry it, the 'alpha' is the filler factor (REJECT as a stake-build alpha).

DECILE t-STAT MEASUREMENT (exact): for decile d, active_d(month) = EW_top_return_d - BM_Ret; portfolio-alpha t_d = NW-lag3 t of regressing active_d on constant (build_benchmark_compare Portfolio_Alpha_t_NW_lag3). D10-D9 gap: g(month)=active_D10 - active_D9; gap-t = mean(g)/NW-lag3-se(g), lag=3. Also report bootstrap (block=12) 90% CI on D10 alpha to flag short-sample fragility.

EXPLICIT short/flat guard: report fraction of D10 months with NEGATIVE active return and the D10 max-drawdown; a 'top' that is high-mean but >40% negative-months or that flips to net-short in OOS half FAILS the genuineness test regardless of full-sample t.
build_steps: 1. specs.name: M33_Confirmed_Donchian_Breakout
specs.construction:
개념 핵심 = 52주 고점을 "연속 비율(M06)"이 아니라 "최초 돌파 이벤트(first-crossing event)"로 재정의. 횡단면 score = [event 발생] × [base 성숙도 gate] × [돌파 신선도]의 곱 → top decile에만 신호 집중(flat D1-D8, spike D9-D10).

정확 신호식 (PIT t-1, sig_date 기준, 모든 입력 Date<=sig_date):
종목 i, 월말 신호일 sig_date에서 일봉 윈도우 W_i = RAWDATA[Ticker==i & Date<=sig_date], setorder(Date asc), n=.N, t=n(가장 최근 거래일). 표기: Close_s, High_s = s번째 거래일 종가/일중고점.

(1) Donchian 상단 채널 — 현재 바 제외(자기참조 방지):
  DC_up(s, L) = max(High_{s-L} ... High_{s-1})   # L=252 기본, 바 s의 High/Close 미포함.
  M06 대비 결정적 차이 2가지: (a) max(High) 사용(M06은 max(Close)), (b) 현재 바 제외(M06은 포함→비율 상한 1.0 강제·diffuse).

(2) Close-confirmation 돌파 이벤트:
  BREAK_s = 1[ Close_s > DC_up(s, 252) ]   # 종가가 직전 252일 일중고점을 갱신 = 확정 돌파(intraday wick 가짜돌파 배제).

(3) Base-length gate (>=126d):
  직전 252일 중 prior_break가 마지막으로 1이었던 시점 s*를 찾아 base_age = t - s*. 그런 s*가 없으면 base_age = (윈도우 내 직전돌파 미발생 거래일수). BASE_OK = 1[ base_age >= 126 ]   # 최소 126거래일 신고가 미발생(=진짜 base 형성) 후의 돌파만 인정.

(4) 돌파 신선도/깊이 (top-concentration 분리축 — D9 vs D10 gap 생성):
  pierce_depth = Close_t / DC_up(t,252) - 1   # 채널 위로 얼마나 뚫었나(얕을수록 '갓 돌파', 깊을수록 이미 연장됨/추격).
  break_count_20d = sum_{s=t-19..t} 1[Close_s > DC_up(s,252)];  fresh = 1[ break_count_20d <= 2 ]

(5) 최종 횡단면 raw score (higher=선호):
  RAW_i = BREAK_t · BASE_OK · g(pierce_depth) · h(fresh)
  g(pierce_depth) = 1 - min(pierce_depth/0.15, 1)   # 갓 돌파(얕음)에 가중. 변형 grid에서 g≡1(평탄)도 테스트.
  h(fresh) = 1 + 0.5·fresh
  비-이벤트 종목(BREAK_t=0 또는 BASE_OK=0)은 RAW=0 → 한 덩어리 bottom group. 이벤트 종목만 양수 → D9~D10 spike(top-concentration 구조의 핵심).
  canonical_screen_bt는 -score로 top_n을 뽑으므로 RAW를 score로 직접 전달(변형 A=raw, 변형 B=이벤트 종목 내 rank만 스케일).
specs.estimator: 횡단면 event-score (회귀 추정 없음 — rule-based). 핵심 계산 = (a) Donchian 채널 max(High) rolling 252d 현재바 제외, (b) base_age 카운터 — 둘 다 rolling-window 결정적 계산이라 파라미터 fit 불필요. 포트폴리오 단계 = canonical_screen_bt의 top-N EW long-only(추정기 없는 동일가중). 성능수치 추정기 = build_benchmark_compare의 NW lag-3 포트폴리오-알파 회귀(forge-authoritative). pierce_depth·base_age는 진단용 연속변수이지 fit 대상 아님. decile 수익률은 Return.portfolio 표준함수 경유(prod(1+r) 자체합성 금지).
specs.lookback_grid: 채널 길이 L ∈ {126, 189, 252(기본), 378}거래일. base-length gate ∈ {126(기본), 189, 252}거래일. fresh 윈도우 ∈ {10, 20(기본)}, K(허용 돌파횟수) ∈ {1, 2(기본), 3}. pierce_depth cap ∈ {0.10, 0.15(기본), no-cap(g≡1)}. top_n ∈ {15, 20(기본), 25}. 주의: L과 base gate 동시 sweep = trial 급증 → DSR HARD(selection_type='sweep'). 사전등록 primary 1스펙(L=252·base=126·top_n=20·g=깊이가중·fresh=20/K2)을 고정하고 나머지는 robustness grid로 분리 보고 권장(primary는 single/chain → DSR 면제, grid는 sweep → DSR 적용).
specs.data_inputs: RAWDATA 일봉 OHLC: Date, Ticker, High(필수 — Donchian 상단), Close(돌파 확인·pierce_depth), Vol(유동성 adv). 주의: compute_momentum.R가 소비하는 표준 RAWDATA 스냅샷 컬럼은 Close/Ret/Vol/Size/Sector/BM_Ret이며 High/Low/Open이 그 스냅샷에 노출되지 않음 — High는 raw OHLCV parquet carve-out에서 별도 로드 필요(C15 명시 승인 또는 close-only 폴백). 벤치: BM_Ret(KOSPI200 total return, bench_dt). 유니버스: universe_support/*.parquet의 K200·KQ150 시점 멤버십(apply_universe_mapping.R, us_k200/us_kq150). 유동성: adv = rolling 20d mean(Vol×Close) at t-1. forward 수익: Ret_1m(t→t+1 month 실현, PIT forward label). 외부데이터·크로스마켓 미사용(개념상 OHLC only).
specs.pit_notes: C1(full-sample 금지): 채널·base·pierce 전부 rolling window만, expanding 통계 없음. 초기 history 부족 종목은 NA(in-sample 채움 금지). C2(same-day circular): DC_up은 High_{s-1}까지만(현재 바 t의 High/Close 미포함) → 자기참조 원천 차단. C3: 신고가 판정에 forward 정보 미사용. C5(overlay t-1): 모든 신호 컴포넌트가 sig_date 이하 종가 산출, 적용은 t+1. C6(survivorship): 멤버십은 sig_date 시점 K200/KQ150만(사후 편입/생존 선택 금지). C7(lookahead_detector): break_count_20d·base_age는 과거 인덱스만 참조 — validate_label_direction + lookahead_detector PASS 의무. C10(유동성 t-1): adv는 Date<sig_date 20일창. C14: IC 산출 시 score Date<=sig_date. C15: High carve-out은 load_month_factors 우회이므로 명시 승인 hypothesis로만(close-only 폴백은 RAWDATA 표준컬럼이라 무관). forward label Ret_1m은 bear_date_audit.R 통과 의무(Cycle 50 lookahead 재발 방지).
specs.top_concentration_test:
목적: 극단 top(D10)이 실제 초과수익인지, 아니면 결국 flat/음수인지 검증 — honest_risks 핵심 실패모드 직격.
(1) Decile profile: 각 월 score로 D1..D10 분할. 문제 = 비-이벤트 종목 다수가 RAW=0(동점)이라 표준 decile 붕괴 → 2방식 병행: (a) 이벤트 종목(RAW>0)만 별도 모집단으로 그 안에서 D1..D10(=신선도/깊이 decile), (b) 전체에서 top group(이벤트∩base)=가장 위 vs 나머지. 각 decile EW long-only 월수익을 Return.portfolio 표준함수로 구성, 전기간 평균·SR·active(−BM) 산출.
(2) D10 t-stat: D10 종목만으로 canonical_screen_bt 호출 → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3(NW lag-3) + D10-only net active SR. D10 t<2 = '극단 top 통계적 alpha 없음' 경고.
(3) D10-D9 gap: (D10 active mean − D9 active mean) + 그 차이의 NW t-stat(공매도 미사용·진단 전용, 배포는 D10만). gap>0 ∧ t_gap>1.5 = '진짜 극단 집중'. gap<=0 = 'top이 mid-peaking/diffuse'(M06 병폐 재현=reframe 실패).
(4) Monotonicity: D1→D10 active 단조증가(Spearman of decile rank vs decile mean active). 비단조 = 서사 미성립.
(5) Sparse-event 라벨: 월평균 이벤트 종목수<25면 (a)방식 decile 불가 시점 표시. 이벤트 희소·군집(강세장 다발) 시 top decile이 곧 시장 베타 → active basis 재확인 필수.
판정: D10 PORT_t>=2.95 ∧ D10-D9 gap t>1.5 ∧ 단조성 PASS = top-concentration 입증. 하나라도 실패 시 screen-tier 강등 또는 기각.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
월별 횡단면 spearman rank corr 평균 + active-basis 시계열 corr 둘 다 측정:
- M06_High_52w (Close/max(Close) 252d 비율): 최우선 직교 타깃, 목표 |corr|<0.5. 이 팩터 존재이유가 '이벤트 vs 비율' reframe이므로 M06과 0.6+면 reframe 실패=기각 신호. 이벤트(discrete) vs 비율(continuous)·max(High) vs max(Close)·현재바 제외 vs 포함이 분리를 만들어야 함.
- M16_Trend_Factor (MA-cross aggregate): 목표 |corr|<0.5. 둘 다 가격-트렌드라 중간 상관 예상 — close-confirmation+base gate가 차별점.
- M01_Mom_12_1 / M05_Trended_Mom: 목표 |corr|<0.6. 같은 price-momentum 패밀리(rationale가 인정한 한계) — 직교성보다 '이벤트 타이밍의 marginal 정보 추가'를 ΔIR로 검증.
- M17_Low_52w: 부호 반대 예상, 직교 타깃 아님.
종합: M06 active-basis |corr|<0.5가 hard 직교 합격선. 미달 시 '비싼 M06 재포장' 결론. book-marginal은 §4 ΔIR>=0.05(현 book/STR_1715 대비 |cor|<0.30) 별도 검증.
build_steps: S1. 데이터 carve-out: 일봉 OHLC parquet 확보. RAWDATA 표준 스냅샷은 Close/Ret/Vol/Size/Sector/BM_Ret만 노출(compute_momentum.R L5) — High가 표준 스냅샷에 없으면 raw OHLCV parquet에서 Date/Ticker/High/Close 별도 로드(C15 carve-out 명시 승인). High 부재 시 close-only Donchian(max(Close_{s-L..s-1}))로 폴백하되 metric_type에 'close_only_donchian' 명시.
S2. 유니버스·멤버십 PIT 정렬: 각 sig_date에서 universe_support/*.parquet의 K200/KQ150 시점 멤버십으로 KOSPI200∪KQ150 필터(apply_universe_mapping.R 경유, us_k200/us_kq150). 멤버십은 sig_date 시점 값만(미래 진입 배제, C6).
S3. 월별 루프: 각 월말 sig_date에 종목별 일봉 윈도우(Date<=sig_date)로 DC_up(252, 현재바 제외)·BREAK_t·base_age·pierce_depth·break_count_20d 계산. history n<378(252 채널+126 base) 미만 종목은 NA(early-period NA, in-sample 통계 금지).
S4. RAW score 산출(construction (5)) → scores_dt(Date, Ticker, score=RAW). 진단용 컬럼(BREAK_t, BASE_OK, pierce_depth, base_age, fresh) 보존 → top_concentration_test용.
S5. returns_dt 구성: forward 1M 실현수익 Ret_1m(t→t+1 month, PIT forward label, validate_label_direction PASS). bench_dt = KOSPI200 total return(BM_Ret 월간).
S6. liq_dt: t-1 기준 20일 평균 거래대금(adv=mean(Vol·Close), Date<sig_date) → liq_min=2e8 필터(C10).

S7. canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) 실측 호출 → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 / IR / net_sr / turnover_annual 수령. top_n grid {15,20,25}.
S8. top_concentration_test 실행: decile profile + D10 t-stat + D10-D9 gap + 단조성. 월평균 이벤트 종목<25면 sparse-event 라벨링.
S9. orthogonality: M06/M16/M01과 횡단면 rank corr(월별 spearman 평균) + active-basis 시계열 corr. M06 active |corr|>=0.5 시 'M06 재포장' 라벨.
S10. 변형 grid 채점(g≡1 vs 깊이가중, fresh on/off, base 126 vs 252, 변형 A raw vs B 이벤트내rank). DSR selection_type='sweep'(열거 grid argmax) → DSR>=0.5 HARD. 단일 사전등록 스펙만 보고 시 chain.
S11. 게이트: graduation tier(PORT_t>=2.95·oos_retention>=0.7·calmar>=0.64) + screening tier(SR>=0.7∧CAGR>=12% 또는 score>=40∧SR>=0.5) 동시 산출. PIT 위반만 절대 기각.
specs.honest_risks:
1. Top이 결국 flat/음수 위험(가장 정직한 약점): false-breakout. 가격 돌파는 문서화된 실패율이 있고 raw 버전은 미필터(rationale mechanism=3 할인). D10이 '돌파 직후 되돌림'으로 채워지면 active 음수 → top_concentration_test (2)(3)에서 직격. M35(quality-filtered) 우월 주장이 곧 이 위험의 인정.
2. M06 재포장 위험: 이벤트화·max(High)·현재바 제외에도 M06과 active-corr>0.6이면 '비싼 reframe' → 신규성(4) 거짓.
3. 희소·군집 이벤트 → 시장 베타 위장: 돌파는 강세장 다발(KR long-only β≈0.99 바닥). 이벤트 종목이 곧 고베타 상승주면 gross 초과가 active(−BM)에선 소멸(measurement-graduation §6: gross 0.78 vs active 0.45). active-basis 검증 필수.
4. KR 디스포지션 증폭의 부호 역전: retail disposition이 overhead-supply(돌파 후 본전매도압)를 키우면 오히려 top이 short여야 정상 — KR에서 메커니즘 부호 반전 가능(M22 Max-Return KR 음프리미엄과 동류). 역전 시 kr-inverse-pattern-miner 후보.
5. Sparse-event로 top_n 미충족: 일부 월 이벤트∩base<20 → 포트가 비-이벤트로 강제 충원(신호 희석). 월별 이벤트수 분포 보고 의무.
6. High carve-out 부재 시 close-only 폴백 = 개념 핵심(intraday wick 배제·일중고점 채널) 훼손 → 별도 팩터로 라벨.
7. 회전율 폭증: 이벤트는 1회성이라 매월 대량 교체 가능 → turnover>1100% screening hard fail 위험. turnover_annual 모니터 + 15bps 실측.
8. DSR: L·base·fresh·pierce 동시 grid는 sweep → selection bias. 사전등록 primary 1스펙 고정 안 하면 DSR>=0.5 HARD 탈락 가능.
specs.pit_notes_supplement: 데이터 가용성 검증 선행: alpha-research는 빌드 전 RAWDATA(또는 raw OHLCV parquet)에 High 컬럼 존재·신선도를 먼저 확인하고, 부재 시 close-only 폴백을 별도 팩터(M33b)로 라벨링하여 두 버전을 분리 채점할 것. 멤버십 parquet의 시점 정합도 sig_date별 1건 이상 확인.

dropped.name: C31_Dividend_Initiation_Surprise
dropped.reason: Top-concentration weak for the 2005+ campaign window: dividend INITIATIONS are genuinely rare events, but the candidate itself flags KR's low pre-2015 payer base rate means early-period event counts are too thin for statistical power, AND it brushes against AX-003 (KR value/EP_STANDALONE failure) — the author argues 'event not yield' but the forward drift of a payout-commitment signal is empirically entangled with the value/yield factor that already failed in KR. Mechanism plausible but the historical-power gap + AX-003 proximity make it a weaker bet than the buyback events that share the 'commitment signal' logic without the yield contamination or the thin early-window. Dominated by C27/M_BuybackDrift.

dropped.name: M_BuybackValidatedBreakout
dropped.reason: Triple-gate buyback × breakout × liquidity-expansion. Dominated/redundant: it is a strictly more selective sibling of M37 (which already gates buyback × breakout) and M_BuybackDrift_Confirmed — the candidate explicitly positions itself as a 'lower-feasibility variant for robustness comparison.'
